topics.title: Telling a story
topics.description: Sequencing past events with 著 and directional verbs

guide.intro: When you narrate a story you need ways to set the scene ("she was sitting"), describe motion ("he walked in"), and string events together. 著 handles ongoing states; directional complements like 上來 and 下去 handle motion in space.

sections.text: 著 — ongoing state
著 (zhe) attached to a verb means "in the state of doing". It's NOT the same as English -ing — 著 emphasizes a held position or background condition, often setting the scene.

rows.translation: He is standing. (in a standing state)
The door is open. (held open)

rows.source: 她 笑 著 說。
rows.translation: She said with a smile. (smiling-while-speaking)

sections.text: 著 vs 在: 在 means "actively doing right now" ("我 在 吃飯" — I'm eating). 著 means "in this state" ("門 開 著" — the door's open). For narration, 著 sets the scene; 在 reports a live action.
Directional complements: 上 / 下 / 進 / 出 / 來 / 去
Six little words combine into rich verbs of motion. Pair a base direction (up/down/in/out) with 來 (toward speaker) or 去 (away from speaker).

rows.source: 他 走 進來 了。
rows.translation: He walked in.

rows.source: 她 跑 出去 了。
rows.translation: She ran out.
Please come up.

sections.text: Figurative directionals — 起來 / 下去 / 出來
Directional complements stretch beyond physical motion. Attached to non-motion verbs, they signal phase or aspect: starting, continuing, or coming-to-clarity.

rows: 看 起來 很 累 — looks tired

rows.source: 我 終於 想 出來 了。
rows.translation: I finally figured it out.

rows.source: 請 你 說 下 去。
rows.translation: Please keep talking.

rows.source: 他 突然 笑 起來 了。
rows.translation: He suddenly started to laugh.

sections.text: Sequencing words
A2's 然後 still works, but B1 stories add 先...再... (first...then...), 最後 (finally), 突然 (suddenly), and 後來 (afterward — for events further apart).

rows.source: 我 先 吃飯，再 看 電影。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ xiān chīfàn, zài kàn diànyǐng.
rows.translation: First I'll eat, then watch a movie.
It suddenly started to rain.

rows.source: 後來 他 搬 走 了。
rows.translation: Afterward, he moved away.

levels.name: B2 — Upper Intermediate
levels.description: Discuss abstract topics, defend opinions, and handle the news, the workplace, and contemporary Chinese culture.

topics.title: Expressing opinions
topics.description: Hedge, agree, push back, and stack reasons

guide.intro: At B2 you stop just stating opinions and start structuring them — adding nuance, layering reasons, and naming the side you fall on. Three patterns will carry most of your opinion-talk for the rest of your Chinese life: 不僅…而且 (not only…but also), 我覺得…比較 (I think…relatively), and 一方面…另一方面 (on one hand…on the other).

sections.text: 不僅…而且 — not only…but also

不僅 (bù jǐn) sets up the first half of a two-part claim, and 而且 (ér qiě) adds the second, usually stronger, point. The two halves can share a subject (which sits in front) or have different subjects (which sit after each particle).

rows.source: 他不僅會說中文，而且會說日語。
rows.pinyin: Tā bù jǐn huì shuō Zhōngwén, ér qiě huì shuō Rìyǔ.
rows.translation: He not only speaks Chinese, but also Japanese.

rows.source: 這家餐廳不僅便宜，而且很好吃。
rows.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng bù jǐn piányi, ér qiě hěn hǎo chī.
rows.translation: This restaurant is not only cheap but also delicious.

rows.source: 不僅我喜歡他，而且我妹妹也喜歡他。
rows.pinyin: Bù jǐn wǒ xǐhuan tā, ér qiě wǒ mèimei yě xǐhuan tā.
rows.translation: Not only do I like him, but my sister does too.

sections.text: Common mistake: dropping 而且 and joining with a comma. In Mandarin, 不僅 always pairs with 而且 (or 也 / 還). "他不僅高，帥" sounds incomplete.
Softening: 我覺得 + 比較

比較 (bǐ jiào) means "relatively" or "fairly" — it takes the edge off an opinion the way "kind of" does in English. Pair it with 我覺得 (wǒ jué de, "I feel") for a polite, hedged tone that won't sound confrontational.

rows.source: 我覺得這個想法比較有意思。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ jué de zhè ge xiǎngfǎ bǐ jiào yǒu yì si.
rows.translation: I think this idea is fairly interesting.

rows.source: 我覺得他說的比較有道理。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ jué de tā shuō de bǐ jiào yǒu dào lǐ.
rows.translation: I think what he said makes a fair amount of sense.

sections.text: Two sides: 一方面…另一方面
Use 一方面 (yī fāng miàn)…另一方面 (lìng yī fāng miàn) to lay out two sides of the same issue — the closest Mandarin gets to "on one hand…on the other hand".

rows.source: 一方面工作很累，另一方面工資也不高。
rows.pinyin: Yī fāng miàn gōng zuò hěn lèi, lìng yī fāng miàn gōng zī yě bù gāo.
rows.translation: On one hand the work is tiring, on the other hand the pay isn't great either.

lessons.title: I think, I feel
lessons.description: Stating a view with 覺得 and 認為

exercises.prompt: What's the difference between 覺得 and 認為?
options: 覺得 is more casual/feeling-based; 認為 is more considered/formal
覺得 means "think"; 認為 means "feel"
exercises.answer: 覺得 is more casual/feeling-based; 認為 is more considered/formal

exercises.prompt: Build "I think this movie is really worth watching"

I think what he said makes sense
acceptableAnswers: I believe what he said makes sense
I think he has a point

exercises.prompt: Which is the most natural way to soften "I think it's expensive"?
exercises.explanation: 有點兒 (yǒu diǎnr) before an adjective is what does the softening — without it, 我覺得貴 is grammatical but blunt.

exercises.prompt: Build a more formal opinion: "I personally believe this idea is worth considering"

exercises.explanation: 我個人認為 (wǒ gè rén rèn wéi) lifts the register — 個人 ("personally") plus 認為 sounds essay-like; 我覺得 would be the casual swap.

exercises.prompt: A friend asks 你覺得這家餐廳怎麼樣? Which reply HEDGES the most?
exercises.explanation: 還行吧 ("it's okay, I guess") plus 比較一般 ("relatively average") is the classic Chinese hedge — neither praising nor trashing.

exercises.source: 在我看來，這件事沒那麼簡單
exercises.answer: In my view, this matter isn't that simple
acceptableAnswers: From my perspective, it's not that simple
The way I see it, this isn't so simple
In my opinion, this isn't that simple
exercises.explanation: 在我看來 (zài wǒ kàn lái) — "in my view". A common B2 opener for stating an opinion with a touch more weight than 我覺得.

exercises.prompt: the opinion-opener to its register

pairs.right: Stating a view: in my view

options: 我覺得他說得有點兒不對

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "我覺得對" into a more formal/considered opinion. The blank should fill in: "我 ___ 這個觀點是正確的"
exercises.explanation: Swap 覺得 → 認為 to lift register. 我認為這個觀點是正確的 — "I believe this view is correct".

options: 在 我 看 來
在 我 來 看

exercises.explanation: 在我看來 (zài wǒ kàn lái) is a fixed four-syllable opener — the order is locked.

exercises.prompt: Yesterday I read this article. Pick the natural Mandarin order — time word placement:
exercises.explanation: In Chinese, time words go before the verb — usually at the start of the clause or right after the subject. "我看了這篇文章昨天" (English order) is wrong.

exercises.prompt: English: "Because the movie was long, so I left." In Chinese, picking BOTH 因為 and 所以 is fine. But which natural rendering matches B2 register?
options: 因為電影太長了，所以我就走了。
因為電影太長了，我就走了所以。
我走了所以因為電影太長。
電影太長所以因為我走了。
exercises.answer: 因為電影太長了，所以我就走了。
exercises.explanation: Unlike English, where doubling "because…so" sounds redundant, Chinese commonly uses both 因為…所以…together. Just keep them at the start of each clause.

exercises.source: 我個人認為這個想法值得考慮
exercises.answer: Personally I believe this idea is worth considering
acceptableAnswers: I personally believe this idea deserves consideration
In my personal view this idea is worth thinking about

acceptableAnswers: I feel he has a fairly reasonable point

lessons.description: Stack reasons with 不僅…而且

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is GRAMMATICALLY WRONG?
exercises.explanation: 不僅 must pair with 而且 / 還 / 也. A bare comma is not enough — the second clause needs a connector.

exercises.prompt: 不僅 cannot pair with which of these?
exercises.explanation: 但是 introduces contrast ("but"). 不僅 needs an additive partner: 而且, 還, or 也.

exercises.prompt: Convert single-clause to compound: "He's hardworking and talented" → use 不僅...而且

exercises.prompt: "這部電影不僅好看，___ 很有意義"

Not only does involution affect young people, it affects all of society

lessons.title: Agree & disagree
lessons.description: 同意, 反對, and the polite middle

exercises.prompt: the phrase to its meaning

exercises.answer: She is both pretty and smart

She's pretty as well as smart

exercises.prompt: Build "Everything has two sides — one hand the advantages, on the other the disadvantages"

exercises.prompt: Pick the GRAMMATICALLY CORRECT sentence:
options: 這個工作既穩定又有意思
這個工作既穩定也有意思
一方面工作很累也另一方面工資不高
exercises.answer: 這個工作既穩定又有意思

exercises.prompt: Tap the two-sided opener you hear

凡 事 兩 面
一 方 二 面

lessons.title: Dialogue: Discussing a film at a coffee shop

exercises.prompt: Coffee-shop chat about a film you saw last night

turns.speaker: mia

turns.spokenText: 你昨天看的那部電影怎麼樣？

turns.answer: 我覺得劇情比較拖沓，不過演技不錯。(Wǒ juéde jùqíng bǐjiào tuōtà, búguò yǎnjì búcuò.)

turns.speaker: mia

完全同意而且非常好。(Wánquán tóngyì érqiě fēicháng hǎo.)
不知道我無所謂的吧。(Bù zhīdào wǒ wúsuǒwèi de ba.)
turns.answer: 我部分同意，不過那些慢鏡頭反而很有味道。(Wǒ bùfèn tóngyì, búguò nàxiē màn jìngtóu fǎn'ér hěn yǒu wèidào.)

turns.speaker: mia
turns.text: 說得也是。導演想表達的主題你看懂了嗎？(Shuō de yěshì. Dǎoyǎn xiǎng biǎodá de zhǔtí nǐ kàndǒng le ma?)
turns.spokenText: 說得也是。導演想表達的主題你看懂了嗎？

turns.speaker: you

turns.speaker: mia

強烈不推薦，肯定別看了。(Qiángliè bù tuījiàn, kěndìng bié kàn le.)
可以看也可以不看反正都行。(Kěyǐ kàn yě kěyǐ bù kàn fǎnzhèng dōu xíng.)

turns.speaker: mia
turns.text: 好，我下週找時間去看。(Hǎo, wǒ xià zhōu zhǎo shíjiān qù kàn.)
turns.spokenText: 好，我下週找時間去看。

exercises.prompt: Pick the connector for half-agreement ("I partly agree, but..."):

exercises.prompt: Build: "Those slow shots actually have flavor"

exercises.prompt: Hedge with "maybe": "我覺得___是在講家庭的疏離感"
What does 貫穿全片 mean?

exercises.answer: I recommend watching it, but you need patience
acceptableAnswers: recommended, but you need to be patient
I'd recommend it, though you'll need patience

exercises.prompt: The phrase 反而 signals:
exercises.explanation: 反而 = "on the contrary / surprisingly" — it flips an expectation.

exercises.prompt: Theme runs through the film: "那種感覺確實___全片"
Tap the hedge you hear
exercises.spokenText: 我 覺 得 大 概

我 大 概 覺 得

覺 得 我 大 概

exercises.prompt: Build: "Recommended, but you need patience"

推薦看因此節奏比較慢

the topic the director wanted to express

topics.title: News & current events
topics.description: Read a headline, summarize what happened, give your take

lessons.title: News vocabulary
lessons.description: 新聞, 報道, 媒體 — the building blocks

exercises.prompt: the term to its meaning
What does "頭條新聞" (tóu tiáo xīn wén) mean?
exercises.explanation: 頭條 literally means "top entry" — but it's also the name of a hugely popular news app, 今日頭條.

exercises.prompt: the news-vocabulary term
What does "自媒體" (zì méi tǐ) mean?
exercises.explanation: 自媒體 — literally "self-media". The Weibo / WeChat public accounts ecosystem; contrasted with 傳統媒體 (traditional media).

exercises.prompt: online vs traditional media term
Build "This piece of news got onto the trending list (熱搜)"
exercises.answer: 這 條 新聞 上 了 熱搜

exercises.prompt: What does "假新聞" (jiǎ xīn wén) mean?
Build "Today's headline news is about education reform"
exercises.answer: 今天 的 頭條 新聞 是 關於 教育 改革

exercises.prompt: Tap the news vocab you hear
exercises.spokenText: 突 發 新 聞
options: 突 發 新 聞
頭 條 新 聞
突 然 新 聞
熱 門 新 聞
exercises.answer: 突 發 新 聞
exercises.explanation: 突發 (tū fā) — "suddenly occurring" — pairs with 新聞 to form the breaking-news idiom. Don't confuse with 頭條 (headline) or 突然 (suddenly).

exercises.prompt: Which is the most NEWS-REGISTER way to start a sentence?
options: 我朋友說今天那個事兒…
exercises.explanation: 據相關媒體報道 — "according to relevant media reports" — the standard news opener. The casual options would never appear in a print or anchor segment.

exercises.prompt: English speakers often drop 了 in past narration. "The earthquake happened yesterday" — which is correct?
exercises.explanation: Past completion of a specific event needs 了 after the verb. Dropping it sounds like a generic / habitual statement.

exercises.prompt: Resultative complement — "I read the article" (and finished it). Pick the natural form:
exercises.explanation: English "I read the article" implies completion, but Chinese 看 alone just means "look at". 看完 (read-finish) explicitly marks the result.

exercises.context: jù xiāng guān méi tǐ bào dào

exercises.prompt: Build "Today's breaking news is about education reform"
exercises.answer: 今天 的 突發 新聞 是 關於 教育 改革

exercises.prompt: What does "自媒體" refer to?
exercises.explanation: 自媒體 — WeChat public-account / Weibo-style independent media.

exercises.prompt: "這 條 新聞 ___ 了 熱搜"
exercises.explanation: 上熱搜 = make it onto the trending search list. 上 here is the verb "to ascend onto".

exercises.prompt: Tap the news term you hear
exercises.explanation: 記者 (jì zhě) — reporter. 4th tone + neutral tone. Common in news bylines.

lessons.title: What happened?
lessons.description: 發生, 引起, 影響 — narrating events

exercises.prompt: What does "發生" (fā shēng) mean?
Build "This event has had a big impact on society"
exercises.answer: 這件 事 對 社會 有 很大 的 影響

exercises.context: yǐn qǐ guǎng fàn guān zhù

exercises.prompt: What does "事故" (shì gù) mean?
the verb to its meaning
Convert active to passive: "The accident was caused by drunk driving" using 被
exercises.answer: 這 起 事故 是 由 酒駕 造成 的
exercises.explanation: News register prefers 是…由…造成的 over plain 被. 由 marks the agent. 起 is the measure word for incidents.

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "This decision will have far-reaching effects":
options: 這個決定會產生深遠的影響
exercises.answer: 這個決定會產生深遠的影響
exercises.explanation: 產生影響 — "produce an impact" — is the standard collocation. 深遠 ("far-reaching") is essay-register.

exercises.source: 事件 (shì jiàn) 引發了 公眾 的 關注
acceptableAnswers: The incident set off public attention
exercises.explanation: 引發 = trigger / set off — slightly stronger and more news-y than 引起.

exercises.prompt: Build "The incident drew widespread attention from society"
exercises.answer: 這 件 事 引起 了 社會 的 廣泛 關注

exercises.prompt: Pick the news-headline-style passive: "The suspect was arrested":
exercises.explanation: Headlines use formal verbs: 逮捕 (arrest) over casual 抓. 警方 over casual 警察.

exercises.answer: So far it has caused multiple injuries
acceptableAnswers: As of now, multiple people have been injured
Currently it has caused several people to be injured
exercises.context: mù qián yǐ zào chéng duō rén shòu shāng
exercises.explanation: 目前 (currently) is the news-register version of 現在. 已 (already) is its 已經 equivalent. Strip the casualness for an anchor's voice.

exercises.prompt: Tap the verb you hear
exercises.explanation: 導致 (dǎo zhì) is more clinical and explanatory; 引起 (yǐn qǐ) is more general; 造成 (zào chéng) emphasizes negative outcomes. All three appear in news but the verb you hear here is 導致.

exercises.source: 這件事引起了廣泛關注
acceptableAnswers: This incident has attracted widespread attention
The matter has caused broad public attention

exercises.prompt: Build "The accident caused multiple injuries"
exercises.answer: 這 起 事故 造成 了 多 人 受傷

exercises.prompt: Which verb is the most CLINICAL (cause-effect explanation)?
exercises.explanation: 導致 — "lead to" — neutral and clinical. 造成 emphasizes negative outcomes; 引起 is more general.

exercises.prompt: News register: "這 個 決定 會 ___ 深遠 的 影響"
exercises.explanation: 產生影響 — "produce an impact" — standard collocation in news/essay register.

exercises.answer: The suspect was arrested by the police
acceptableAnswers: The suspect has been arrested by police

exercises.prompt: Build "This event sparked public attention"
exercises.answer: 這 件 事 引發 了 公眾 的 關注

exercises.prompt: Best news-register version of "Currently, multiple people have been injured":
exercises.explanation: 目前 (now, formal) + 已 (already, formal) + 造成 — three news-register markers.

exercises.prompt: Tap the verb you hear
exercises.explanation: 造成 (zào chéng) — "bring about" (often negative). 4th tone + 2nd tone.

lessons.title: Politics & society
lessons.description: 政府, 政策, 社會 — the public sphere

exercises.prompt: the term to its meaning
Build "The government has launched a new policy"
exercises.answer: 政府 出 臺 了 一 項 新 政策

exercises.prompt: the public-sphere term
What does "出臺" (chū tái) mean in the context of policy?
exercises.explanation: 出臺 here is news-register for "launch". 政府出臺新政策 = the government rolls out a new policy.

exercises.prompt: Build "This policy aims to support young people in starting businesses"
exercises.answer: 這 項 政策 旨在 支援 年輕 人 創業
exercises.explanation: 旨在 (zhǐ zài) — "aims to / is intended to" — formal news collocation. 項 is the measure word for policies.

exercises.answer: The wealth gap / gap between rich and poor

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "The new policy will affect millions of people":
options: 新政策將影響數百萬人
exercises.answer: 新政策將影響數百萬人
exercises.explanation: 將 is the news-register "will". 數百萬 = several million.

exercises.prompt: Build "The government has paid great attention to this issue"
exercises.answer: 政府 對 這 個 問題 非常 重視
exercises.explanation: 重視 — "attach importance to / take seriously". 對...重視 is the standard frame.

exercises.prompt: casual to news-register equivalent

exercises.source: 這是一個值得深思的問題
exercises.answer: This is a question worth deep reflection
acceptableAnswers: This is a topic worth pondering
This is an issue worth thinking about deeply
exercises.explanation: 深思 — "deep reflection" — common in editorials and opinion pieces.

exercises.prompt: Tap the formal connector you hear (anchor delivery)
exercises.explanation: 由於 is the news/written equivalent of 因為. 由此 ("from this") is a follow-on connector. Listen for the second syllable.

exercises.source: 政府出臺了一項新政策
exercises.answer: The government rolled out a new policy
acceptableAnswers: The government has introduced a new policy
A new policy has been launched by the government

exercises.prompt: Build "The new policy will affect millions of people"
exercises.answer: 新 政策 將 影響 數 百萬 人

exercises.prompt: Which is the formal/news-register equivalent of 因為?
exercises.explanation: 由於 is the news/written cousin of 因為. Common in policy reporting.

exercises.prompt: News frame: "這 項 政策 ___ 支援 年輕 人 創業" (aims to)
exercises.explanation: 旨在 — "aims to / is intended to" — formal news collocation.

exercises.source: 政府對這個問題非常重視
exercises.answer: The government takes this issue very seriously
acceptableAnswers: The government attaches great importance to this issue
The authorities pay great attention to this issue

exercises.prompt: Build "The wealth gap is one of society's serious problems"
exercises.answer: 貧富 差距 是 社會 嚴重 問題 之一

exercises.prompt: News-register equivalent of 現在:
exercises.explanation: 目前 — "currently" — formal/news register. 現在 is the casual equivalent.

exercises.prompt: Tap the formal future marker you hear
exercises.explanation: 將 is the formal/news-register "will". 會 is the casual equivalent.

lessons.title: Reading a headline
lessons.description: Compress meaning the way headlines do

exercises.prompt: Headlines often drop particles. "北京 今日 大雪" means:
exercises.explanation: Headlines compress: no 有, no 了 — the reader fills in the verb.

exercises.prompt: Build "According to reports, the issue has been resolved"
exercises.answer: 據 報道 問題 已經 解決 了

exercises.prompt: "專家表示" (zhuān jiā biǎo shì) means:
Tap the headline you hear (read aloud, news-style)
exercises.spokenText: 據 報道 問題 已經 解決 了
options: 據 報道 問題 已經 解決 了
據 報道 政府 已經 決定 了
據 調查 問題 還 沒 解決
據 媒體 報道 經濟 增長 了
exercises.answer: 據 報道 問題 已經 解決 了
exercises.explanation: Headlines are spoken in clipped, declarative cadence. Tune your ear to the opening 據報道 ("according to reports") and the verb-final 解決了 ("resolved").

exercises.prompt: Compress to a headline: "The economy is growing this year" → headline style (drop 在/了)
exercises.answer: 今年 經濟 持續 增長
exercises.explanation: Headlines drop aspect particles and choose a punchier verb (持續 = continuously). Casual full-form would be: 今年經濟在持續增長.

exercises.prompt: "暴雨襲擊北京" — pick the best translation:
exercises.explanation: 襲擊 (xí jī, "strike / attack") is favored in headline metaphors for storms, fires, and disasters.
A stock collocation in finance and economics headlines: 再創新高 = the indicator/price hits another record.

exercises.prompt: the headline verb
Which is HEADLINE register, not casual?
options: 剛剛聽說啊，那個公司倒了
你聽說了嗎，那個公司不行了
exercises.explanation: 宣告 (declare) and 破產 (bankruptcy) are formal verbs. Headlines compress and dignify what casual speech would render with 不行了 / 倒了.

exercises.prompt: Build a headline: "Two countries sign trade agreement" (drop particles)
exercises.answer: 兩 國 簽署 貿易 協議

exercises.prompt: Tap the headline cadence you hear (anchor delivery)
exercises.spokenText: 專 家 表 示 此 事 影 響 深 遠
options: 專 家 表 示 此 事 影 響 深 遠
專 家 表 示 這 件 事 影 響 很 大
專 家 說 這 件 事 沒 什 麼 影 響
新 聞 報 道 這 件 事 的 影 響
exercises.answer: 專 家 表 示 此 事 影 響 深 遠
exercises.explanation: Listen for 此事 (this matter) instead of 這件事 — both mean the same but 此 is news/written register only. Anchors deliver these compressed forms.

exercises.source: 專家表示此事影響深遠
exercises.answer: Experts say this matter will have far-reaching effects
acceptableAnswers: Experts indicate that this incident has profound impact
Experts say the consequences of this are far-reaching

exercises.prompt: Build "According to reports, the issue has been resolved"
exercises.answer: 據 報道 問題 已經 解決

exercises.prompt: Pick the headline-register: "Two countries sign trade agreement":
options: 兩 國 簽署 貿易 協議
兩個國家簽了貿易協議了
exercises.answer: 兩 國 簽署 貿易 協議
exercises.explanation: Headlines drop particles, prefer compact forms: 兩國 (two countries), 簽署 (sign, formal), no 了.

exercises.prompt: Headline cadence: "暴雨 ___ 北京" ("Rainstorm hits Beijing")
exercises.explanation: 襲擊 (xí jī) — "strike/attack" — headline metaphor for storms and disasters.

exercises.prompt: Headline build: "This year the economy continues to grow"
exercises.answer: 今年 經濟 持續 增長

exercises.prompt: Headline-register opener:
exercises.explanation: 據相關媒體報道 — "according to related media reports" — the standard news opener.

exercises.prompt: Tap the headline verb you hear
exercises.explanation: 宣佈 (xuān bù) — "announce". Common in headlines: 公司宣佈.

lessons.title: Generations & society in the news
lessons.description: 80後, 北漂, 趨勢 — vocabulary for stories about people

exercises.prompt: the term

pairs.right: Young migrant chasing work in Beijing

exercises.prompt: What does "趨勢" (qū shì) mean?
Build "More and more young people choose not to get married"
exercises.answer: 越 來 越 多 的 年輕 人 選擇 不 結婚

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "This is a very common phenomenon today":
options: 這是現在很普遍的現象
exercises.answer: 這是現在很普遍的現象

exercises.prompt: the social-trend term
Build "China is becoming an aging society"
exercises.answer: 中國 正在 成為 一 個 老齡化 社會

exercises.source: 內卷已經成為這一代人的關鍵詞
exercises.answer: Involution has become the keyword of this generation
acceptableAnswers: Involution has become a keyword for this generation

guide.intro: 越…越 (yuè…yuè) is one of the most useful patterns at B2 — and one of the prettiest. It means "the more X, the more Y". You'll hear it everywhere from weather reports to op-eds. This topic uses environmental issues as the playground for it.

sections.text: 越…越 — the more…the more
The pattern is fixed: 越 + verb/adjective, 越 + verb/adjective. The two halves can share a subject (which sits at the front) or have different subjects.

rows.pinyin: Tiān qì yuè lái yuè rè.
rows.translation: The weather is getting hotter and hotter.

rows.pinyin: Tā yuè shuō yuè shēng qì.
rows.translation: The more he talked, the angrier he got.
The rain came down heavier and heavier.

sections.text: 越來越 — getting X-er
越來越 (yuè lái yuè) is the most common form: "more and more". It always sits in front of an adjective or stative verb, and signals a trend over time.

rows.pinyin: Kōng qì yuè lái yuè chà.
rows.translation: The air is getting worse and worse.

rows.pinyin: Huán bǎo yuè lái yuè zhòng yào.
rows.translation: Environmental protection is getting more and more important.

sections.text: Don't add 很 between 越來越 and the adjective. "越來越很熱" is wrong — 越來越 already does the intensifying.
Two-subject form
When the two halves have different subjects, both subjects appear inside the pattern, after each 越:

rows.source: 天氣越冷，我越想吃火鍋。
rows.pinyin: Tiān qì yuè lěng, wǒ yuè xiǎng chī huǒ guō.
rows.translation: The colder the weather, the more I want hotpot.

exercises.prompt: "I saw an interesting bug yesterday." Pick the version that handles aspect + time placement correctly:
options: 我昨天看到了一個有趣的bug。

exercises.prompt: What does "996" (jiǔ jiǔ liù) refer to?
exercises.explanation: 996 became a flashpoint in Chinese tech around 2019. The phrase 996.icu — "work 996, end up in the ICU" — went viral.

topics.title: Emotions in depth
topics.description: Beyond happy and sad — frustrated, moved, embarrassed, even-if-I

guide.intro: B2 emotions need B2 grammar. The patterns 即使…也 (even if…still) and 儘管 (although) let you say things like "even if I'm tired, I'll still finish" and "although I'm sad, I'm okay" — exactly the kind of nuance you start needing once you go past 我很高興.

sections.text: 即使…也 — even if…still

即使 (jí shǐ) introduces a hypothetical or extreme condition; the second half always uses 也 (yě, "still") or 還 (hái) to mark that the result holds regardless. Without that 也, the sentence sounds incomplete to a native ear.

rows.pinyin: Jí shǐ xià yǔ, wǒ yě yào qù.
rows.translation: Even if it rains, I'll still go.

rows.pinyin: Jí shǐ hěn lèi, tā yě bù fàng qì.
rows.translation: Even if he's tired, he doesn't give up.

rows.source: 即使沒有錢，我也很快樂。
rows.pinyin: Jí shǐ méi yǒu qián, wǒ yě hěn kuài lè.
rows.translation: Even without money, I'm still happy.

sections.text: 即使 is for hypotheticals ("even if it rains") — events that may or may not happen. 即便 (jí biàn) is a slightly more formal synonym you'll see in writing.
儘管…但是 — although

儘管 (jǐn guǎn) introduces an actual fact (not a hypothetical), and 但是 (dàn shì, "but") or 還是 (hái shi, "still") marks the contrasting follow-up. Use 儘管 when the first clause is true and the second clause is the surprise.

rows.source: 儘管下雨，他還是去跑步了。
rows.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn xià yǔ, tā hái shi qù pǎo bù le.
rows.translation: Although it was raining, he still went running.

rows.source: 儘管我們很努力，但是沒有成功。
rows.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn wǒ men hěn nǔ lì, dàn shì méi yǒu chéng gōng.
rows.translation: Although we tried hard, we didn't succeed.

exercises.prompt: Which is the FORMAL register version?

turns.speaker: kai
turns.text: 聽說你被升職了，怎麼看起來心情有點複雜？(Tīngshuō nǐ bèi shēngzhí le, zěnme kàn qǐlái xīnqíng yǒudiǎn fùzá?)
turns.spokenText: 聽說你被升職了，怎麼看起來心情有點複雜？

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Express mixed feelings (one hand / on the other).
options: 一方面挺開心的，另一方面又怕做不好。(Yī fāngmiàn tǐng kāixīn de, lìng yī fāngmiàn yòu pà zuò bù hǎo.)
開心因此怕另一方面又一方面。(Kāixīn yīncǐ pà lìng yī fāngmiàn yòu yī fāngmiàn.)
心情不需要因為開心一方面。(Xīnqíng bù xūyào yīnwèi kāixīn yī fāngmiàn.)
turns.answer: 一方面挺開心的，另一方面又怕做不好。(Yī fāngmiàn tǐng kāixīn de, lìng yī fāngmiàn yòu pà zuò bù hǎo.)

turns.speaker: kai
turns.text: 正常啦，新崗位壓力大誰都會緊張。(Zhèngcháng la, xīn gǎngwèi yālì dà shéi dōu huì jǐnzhāng.)

turns.speaker: kai

turns.spokenText: 其實這種緊張說明你很在乎。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Name the feeling more precisely.
options: 與其說是緊張，不如說是一種被信任的壓力。(Yǔqí shuō shì jǐnzhāng, bùrú shuō shì yī zhǒng bèi xìnrèn de yālì.)
緊張因此壓力所以信任不如。(Jǐnzhāng yīncǐ yālì suǒyǐ xìnrèn bùrú.)
壓力不需要因為信任緊張。(Yālì bù xūyào yīnwèi xìnrèn jǐnzhāng.)
turns.answer: 與其說是緊張，不如說是一種被信任的壓力。(Yǔqí shuō shì jǐnzhāng, bùrú shuō shì yī zhǒng bèi xìnrèn de yālì.)

turns.speaker: kai
turns.text: 說得很到位，這種感覺我也經歷過。(Shuō de hěn dàowèi, zhè zhǒng gǎnjué wǒ yě jīnglì guò.)
turns.spokenText: 說得很到位，這種感覺我也經歷過。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Express cautious optimism.
options: 希望過一段時間，我能慢慢適應這個節奏。(Xīwàng guò yīduàn shíjiān, wǒ néng mànman shìyìng zhège jiézòu.)
我立刻馬上肯定完全沒問題。(Wǒ lìkè mǎshàng kěndìng wánquán méi wèntí.)
適應不需要因為慢慢節奏。(Shìyìng bù xūyào yīnwèi mànman jiézòu.)
turns.answer: 希望過一段時間，我能慢慢適應這個節奏。(Xīwàng guò yīduàn shíjiān, wǒ néng mànman shìyìng zhège jiézòu.)

turns.speaker: kai
turns.text: 你一定可以的，有需要隨時找我聊。(Nǐ yīdìng kěyǐ de, yǒu xūyào suíshí zhǎo wǒ liáo.)
turns.spokenText: 你一定可以的，有需要隨時找我聊。

topics.title: Defending your view
topics.description: Push back, concede a point, ask sharper questions

lessons.title: Asking sharper questions
lessons.description: 為什麼, 怎麼會, 難道

exercises.prompt: What does "難道" (nán dào) add to a question?
Build "Don't tell me you don't know?"
exercises.answer: 難道 你 不 知道 嗎

acceptableAnswers: How could you possibly think this way?

exercises.prompt: Tap the word you hear
exercises.explanation: 反對 (fǎn duì, "oppose") and 反應 (fǎn yìng, "reaction") share 反 but the second syllable is different — 對 is 4th tone, 應 is 4th tone but with a totally different vowel. Mishearing this in a debate is a real beginner trap.

exercises.prompt: What does "難道X不Y嗎?" express?
options: A rhetorical question with disbelief — "surely X is Y?"
exercises.answer: A rhetorical question with disbelief — "surely X is Y?"
exercises.explanation: 難道 + statement + 嗎 = pushy rhetorical question. 難道你不知道嗎？ = "Don't tell me you don't know!" The expected answer is "of course I do".

exercises.prompt: Build a rhetorical question: "Don't you think this is unfair?"
exercises.answer: 難道 你 不 覺得 這 不 公平 嗎

exercises.prompt: "哪裡有這樣的道理？" (nǎ lǐ yǒu zhè yàng de dào lǐ) is a ___ question.
exercises.explanation: 哪裡 (nǎ lǐ) here is rhetorical, not asking "where". Means "how could there be such a logic?!" — a sharp pushback.

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "How could you say something like that?" (rhetorical):
exercises.explanation: 怎麼能 — "how could (you)" — is the standard structure for outraged rhetorical questions.

exercises.prompt: Build "Why do you say it this way?"
exercises.answer: 你 為 什麼 這麼 說

exercises.prompt: the question type to its tone

acceptableAnswers: There's no way this is possible
exercises.context: zhè zěn me kě néng ne
exercises.explanation: 怎麼可能 — incredulous protest. The 呢 at the end softens it from outrage to genuine bafflement.

exercises.prompt: Tap the rhetorical opener you hear
exercises.explanation: 難道 (nán dào) — "don't tell me that…". Don't confuse with 難怪 (no wonder), 難看 (ugly), or 難受 (uncomfortable). Listen for the 4th-tone 道.

exercises.prompt: 因為…所以… in English requires picking ONE ("because" or "so", not both). In Chinese, which is most natural?
options: 因為他不同意，所以我們沒決定。
因為他不同意，我們沒決定所以。
他不同意因為，我們沒決定所以。
因為他不同意。我們沒決定。
exercises.answer: 因為他不同意，所以我們沒決定。
exercises.explanation: Chinese uses 因為…所以… as a matched pair — keeping both is standard, not redundant like in English. Position: each at the start of its clause.

exercises.prompt: 把 omission — "I sent the proposal to the boss." Most natural?
exercises.explanation: When the verb has a beneficiary (發給) + a definite object (the proposal), 把 puts the object up front and keeps the directional clear. The other orders sound off or ambiguous.

acceptableAnswers: Why would you think this way?
How could you possibly think that?

exercises.prompt: Build "Don't you think this is unfair?"
exercises.answer: 難道 你 不 覺得 這 不 公平 嗎

exercises.prompt: What does "難道X不Y嗎?" express?
exercises.explanation: 難道 + statement + 嗎 = rhetorical with disbelief.

exercises.prompt: Outrage frame: "你 ___ 能 說 出 這 種 話?" (how could)
exercises.explanation: 怎麼能 — "how could (you)" — standard for outraged rhetorical questions.

acceptableAnswers: There's no way this is possible

exercises.prompt: Tap the rhetorical opener you hear
exercises.explanation: 難道 (nán dào) — "don't tell me…". 2nd tone + 4th tone.

lessons.title: Concede then push back
lessons.description: 雖然…但是 — yes, but…

exercises.prompt: What does "雖然…但是" (suī rán…dàn shì) mean?
Build "Although what you said makes sense, I still disagree"
exercises.answer: 雖然 你 說 得 有 道理 但是 我 還是 不 同意
I admit what you said makes sense
acceptableAnswers: I'll grant that you have a point
I admit you have a point

exercises.prompt: the concession opener to its tone
Build "Although your view has its merits, the situation is more complex than you think"
exercises.answer: 雖然 你 的 看法 有 道理 但是 情況 比 你 想 得 複雜

exercises.explanation: 不可否認 — formal essay opener that concedes a fact before offering a counter-argument. "Undeniably X is true, however…"

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "You make a fair point, but I still disagree":
options: 你說得有道理，不過我還是不同意
exercises.answer: 你說得有道理，不過我還是不同意
exercises.explanation: 不過 ("however") + 還是 ("still") is the staple concession-then-pushback structure.

exercises.prompt: Build a formal pushback: "Although what you said is reasonable, we cannot ignore another important factor"
exercises.answer: 儘管 你 說 的 有 道理 但是 我們 不 能 忽視 另 一 個 重要 的 因素
What you say is also right, but…
acceptableAnswers: There's truth to what you're saying, but

exercises.prompt: Pick the formal essay-style concession (not casual):
options: 誠然，A的觀點有其合理性，然而…
exercises.answer: 誠然，A的觀點有其合理性，然而…
exercises.explanation: 誠然 ("to be sure") + 有其合理性 ("has its rationality") + 然而 ("however") — full essay register.

exercises.prompt: Build a layered pushback: "On one hand I admit your point; on the other I think there are problems"
exercises.answer: 一 方面 我 承認 你 的 觀點 另 一 方面 我 認為 也 有 問題

exercises.prompt: Tap the concession word you hear
exercises.explanation: 確實 (què shí) — "indeed/truly" — the strong-agreement concession word. Distinguish from 其實 (actually), 事實 (fact), 真實 (real).

exercises.answer: I admit what you said makes sense
acceptableAnswers: I'll grant that you have a point
I concede you make a fair point

exercises.prompt: Build "Although what you said makes sense, I still disagree"
exercises.answer: 雖然 你 說 得 有 道理 但是 我 還是 不 同意

exercises.prompt: Pick the formal essay opener for an undeniable fact:
exercises.explanation: 不可否認 — "undeniably" — formal essay concession opener.

exercises.prompt: Casual pushback: "你 說 得 有 道理, ___ 我 還是 不 同意" (however)
exercises.explanation: 不過 — "however" — casual conversational alternative to 但是.

exercises.answer: What you say is also right, but…

exercises.prompt: Build "Although your view has merit, the situation is more complex than you think"
exercises.answer: 雖然 你 的 看法 有 道理 但是 情況 比 你 想 得 複雜

exercises.prompt: Which is the FORMAL essay-style concession opener?
options: 誠然，A的觀點有其合理性，然而…
exercises.answer: 誠然，A的觀點有其合理性，然而…
exercises.explanation: 誠然 + 有其合理性 + 然而 — full essay register.

exercises.prompt: Tap the strong-concession word you hear
exercises.explanation: 確實 — "indeed/truly". 4th tone + 2nd tone.

lessons.title: Reasons & evidence
lessons.description: 因為…所以 and 由於

exercises.prompt: What's the difference between 因為 and 由於?
options: 因為 is more conversational; 由於 is more formal/written
因為 is positive; 由於 is negative
exercises.answer: 因為 is more conversational; 由於 is more formal/written

exercises.prompt: Build "Because the weather was bad, the flight was cancelled"
exercises.answer: 因為 天氣 不 好 所以 航班 取消 了

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "There are many reasons for this":
the cause-effect connector to its register

pairs.right: Stylized: the reason X is because Y

exercises.prompt: Build a stylized cause-effect: "The reason I came is because I want to help you" (之所以...是因為)
exercises.answer: 我 之所以 來 是 因為 我 想 幫 你
exercises.explanation: 之所以 X 是因為 Y — flips the order to highlight the cause: "the reason for X is Y". A B2 favorite for emphasis.

exercises.answer: From this we can see / from this it is evident
exercises.explanation: Essay-register transition phrase before drawing a conclusion.

exercises.prompt: Pick the FORMAL written version of "because the weather was bad, the flight was cancelled":
options: 由於天氣惡劣，航班被迫取消
因為天氣不好，航班取消了
exercises.answer: 由於天氣惡劣，航班被迫取消
exercises.explanation: 由於 + 惡劣 (severe, formal) + 被迫 (forced) is news/written register. The casual version uses 因為 + 不好 + 了.

exercises.prompt: Build "Due to limited time, we'll have to discuss this next time"
exercises.answer: 由於 時間 有限 我們 下次 再 討論

acceptableAnswers: There are several reasons listed below
The reasons include the following points
exercises.context: yuán yīn yǒu yǐ xià jǐ diǎn
exercises.explanation: 以下幾點 — "the following several points" — essay structuring phrase before listing reasons.

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "This not only affects me but also affects my family" (不僅...還):
options: 這不僅影響我，還影響我的家人
exercises.answer: 這不僅影響我，還影響我的家人

exercises.prompt: Tap the cause connector you hear
exercises.explanation: 因此 (yīn cǐ, therefore) is paired with 由於 / 因為 to mark the consequence half. Don't confuse with 因為 (because) or 由此 (from this).

exercises.answer: From this we can see / from this it is evident

exercises.prompt: Build "The reason I came is because I want to help you" (之所以...是因為)
exercises.answer: 我 之所以 來 是 因為 我 想 幫 你

exercises.prompt: Formal/written version of 因為:
exercises.explanation: 由於 pairs with 因此 in news/essay register, mirroring 因為...所以.

exercises.prompt: Cause-effect frame: "因為 天氣 不 好, ___ 航班 取消 了"
exercises.explanation: 因為...所以 — Chinese uses BOTH halves as a matched pair, unlike English.

acceptableAnswers: There are several reasons listed below
The reasons are the following points

exercises.prompt: Build "Due to limited time, we'll have to discuss this next time"
exercises.answer: 由於 時間 有限 我們 下次 再 討論

exercises.prompt: Pick the FORMAL written version of "because the weather was bad, the flight was cancelled":
options: 由於天氣惡劣，航班被迫取消
因為天氣不好，航班取消了
exercises.answer: 由於天氣惡劣，航班被迫取消
exercises.explanation: 由於 + 惡劣 + 被迫 — three news-register markers in one sentence.

exercises.prompt: Tap the formal effect connector you hear
exercises.explanation: 因此 (yīn cǐ) — "therefore" — partner of 由於 / 因為 in formal cause-effect.

lessons.title: Closing your argument
lessons.description: 總之, 總的來說 — summing up

exercises.prompt: the closing phrase
Build "In short, I think we should support this plan"
exercises.answer: 總之 我 覺得 我們 應該 支援 這個 計劃
Generally speaking, he's a good person
acceptableAnswers: All in all, he's a good person
Overall, he is a good person

exercises.prompt: the closing/transition phrase to its register

pairs.right: Formal essay: in summary of the above
Stylized: in a word / all things considered
Fundamentally / at the root of it

exercises.prompt: Pick the formal essay-style summary opener:
exercises.explanation: 綜上所述 — "in summary of all the above" — the standard closing transition for a written argument.

exercises.prompt: Build "In short, we should think about this issue from multiple angles"
exercises.answer: 總之 我們 應該 從 多 個 角度 思考 這 個 問題
Fundamentally / at the root of it / when all is said and done
acceptableAnswers: When you trace it to the root
exercises.explanation: Chengyu used to introduce a final fundamental cause: 歸根結底，問題在於… ("fundamentally, the issue is…").

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "In other words, we need to act":
options: 換句話說，我們需要行動
exercises.answer: 換句話說，我們需要行動

exercises.prompt: Build "Generally speaking, this plan has more advantages than disadvantages"

topics.title: Formal communication
topics.description: Emails, speeches, signs — when 你 becomes 您

guide.intro: Mandarin makes a sharp distinction between casual and formal register. The same idea — "Could you please send me the document?" — sounds completely different in a WeChat to a friend versus an email to a client. B2 is where you start being able to switch.

sections.text: Pronouns and politeness

您 (nín) is the polite "you". You'll use it for clients, customers, elders, professors, and strangers in any service context. In groups, 您們 is rare — most speakers stay with 您 (singular) or use 各位 (everyone).
Word swaps that lift the register
Email openers and closers

rows.pinyin: Zūn jìng de Wáng lǎo shī:
rows.translation: Dear (respected) Teacher Wang,
Hello (formal).

rows.pinyin: Gǎn xiè nín de zhī chí.
rows.translation: Thank you for your support.
Wishing you well in business. (formal sign-off)
Yours sincerely / with respect.

sections.text: Casual Chinese loves 啊, 呢, 啦 — the little sentence-final particles that soften tone. Formal Chinese strips them all out. If you find yourself writing 你好啊 to a client, switch back to 您好.
Quick guide: discourse particles
Particles carry no dictionary meaning but huge emotional color. Use them in casual speech; strip them in formal writing.

items: 哎 (āi) — getting attention or expressing mild dismay: 哎，你來一下 (Hey, come here a sec)
哎呀 (āi yā) — "oh!" / "oops!" — surprise or annoyance: 哎呀，又下雨了 (Ugh, it's raining again)
啊 (a) — softens a statement or question: 你好啊 (Hi there) / 真的啊？ (Really?)
呢 (ne) — "and you?" / continuing-state marker: 你呢？ (And you?) / 他在睡覺呢 (He's sleeping [right now])
嘛 (ma) — "obviously" / "as you know": 這是常識嘛 (That's just common sense, isn't it)

topics.title: Common chengyu
topics.description: Four-character idioms (成語) for everyday Chinese

guide.intro: Chengyu (成語, chéng yǔ) are four-character set phrases — the bite-sized literary references that pepper everyday Chinese. They're not optional flavor: native speakers reach for them in casual chat, news headlines, business emails, and parental scoldings alike. Learn 20-30 high-frequency ones at B2 and you'll start hearing them everywhere.

sections.text: What makes a chengyu different from a regular phrase?

Three things. First, the form is fixed: you can't swap words or change the order. Second, the meaning is rarely the sum of the characters — you have to know the story or convention. Third, they pack a lot into four syllables, which is why they're popular in writing.
Treat chengyu like English idioms: "spill the beans" doesn't literally mean spilling beans. The same logic applies to 畫蛇添足 ("draw a snake, add feet").
Where chengyu slot into a sentence
Most chengyu act as a predicate or adverbial — they describe an action or situation. They often sit after the subject, sometimes after 是 / 就是 to label something.

rows.source: 他這樣做簡直是畫蛇添足。
rows.pinyin: Tā zhèyàng zuò jiǎnzhí shì huà shé tiān zú.
rows.translation: What he did was simply gilding the lily.

rows.pinyin: Xué yǔyán bù néng bàn tú ér fèi.
rows.translation: You can't give up halfway when learning a language.

rows.source: 在國外旅行要入鄉隨俗。
rows.pinyin: Zài guówài lǚxíng yào rù xiāng suí sú.
rows.translation: When traveling abroad, do as the locals do.

sections.text: Strategy for learning them

items: Learn the story — it'll make the meaning stick.
Memorize one example sentence per chengyu — the slot matters more than the dictionary gloss.
Don't overuse them. One chengyu per paragraph is plenty; stacking three sounds try-hard.
Listen for them in TV shows and news headlines — they're frequent in both.

sections.text: Don't translate English idioms into chengyu word-for-word. "Kill two birds with one stone" maps to 一舉兩得, not 殺兩鳥一石.

topics.title: B2 review
topics.description: Stitch the patterns together: 越…越, 不僅…而且, 即使…也, 儘管, formal register

lessons.title: Pattern roundup
lessons.description: Pick the right connector

exercises.prompt: the pattern to its meaning
Pick the right connector for a real fact: "___ 下雨，他還是去跑步了"
exercises.explanation: It's a real fact (it actually rained), so 儘管 / 雖然. 即使 would be hypothetical.

exercises.prompt: Pick the right connector: "___ 下雨，我也要去" (you don't yet know if it'll rain)
Pick the right connector: "他 ___ 努力工作，___ 收入很高"
exercises.explanation: Adding two positive qualities → 不僅...而且. The other connectors don't fit "works hard AND earns well" as a parallel additive pair.

exercises.prompt: Build the connector sentence "He not only is smart, he also is hardworking" (use 不僅...而且)
exercises.answer: 他 不僅 聰明 而且 努力
exercises.explanation: 不僅 must pair with an additive (而且 / 還 / 也). It cannot pair with the contrastive 但是 — they push in opposite directions.

exercises.prompt: the connector to its required partner
"環保 ___ 來 ___ 重要" (越…越 pattern)
exercises.explanation: 環保越來越重要 — "environmental protection is more and more important". Both halves of the 越 frame are required.

exercises.prompt: Which is GRAMMATICALLY WRONG?
exercises.explanation: 越來越 already intensifies. Adding 很 doubles up. Drop one or the other.

exercises.prompt: Build "On one hand, the salary is high; on the other hand, the pressure is also great"
exercises.answer: 一方面 工資 很 高 另一方面 壓力 也 很 大

exercises.prompt: "___ 人工智慧 發展 得 很 快, ___ 不 能 完全 取代 人類"
exercises.explanation: Real fact (AI develops fast) + contrast (can't replace humans) → 儘管/雖然...但是 frame.

exercises.prompt: Pick the layered scenario translation: "Even if you disagree, in my view this is still the right thing to do":
options: 即使你不同意，在我看來這也是正確的事
exercises.answer: 即使你不同意，在我看來這也是正確的事
exercises.explanation: Multi-clause B2: 即使...也 (even if...still) + 在我看來 (in my view) — combining concession with opinion-stating in one breath.

exercises.prompt: Tap the connector pair you hear
exercises.spokenText: 不 僅 而 且
options: 不 僅 而 且
盡 管 但 是
雖 然 但 是
exercises.answer: 不 僅 而 且
exercises.explanation: 不僅...而且 — the additive pair. Identifying which connector pair you hear is the first step to parsing complex sentences quickly.

exercises.prompt: Quick review — pick the version that handles ASPECT + RESULT correctly: "I finished the book"
exercises.explanation: 看完 (read-finish) marks the result; 了 marks completion. "我看了那本書" only means "I read the book" — completion is ambiguous.

exercises.prompt: Final trap: "This morning I had a video call with him for an hour." Pick the natural ordering:
options: 今天早上我跟他影片了一個小時。
我影片他今天早上一個小時。
我跟他一個小時今天早上影片。
一個小時我跟他今天早上影片了。
exercises.answer: 今天早上我跟他影片了一個小時。
exercises.explanation: Time (今天早上) comes first, subject (我) next, coverb phrase (跟他), then verb + duration. English-style trailing time/duration doesn't transfer.

exercises.source: 即使你不同意，在我看來這也是正確的事
exercises.answer: Even if you disagree, in my view this is still the right thing to do
acceptableAnswers: Even if you don't agree, I think this is the right thing
Even with your disagreement, I still see this as right

exercises.prompt: Build "He's not only smart, he's also hardworking"

exercises.prompt: Which is GRAMMATICALLY WRONG?
exercises.explanation: 越來越 already intensifies — adding 很 doubles up.

exercises.prompt: Connector quiz: "___ 下雨, 我 也 要 去" (hypothetical)
exercises.explanation: Hypothetical → 即使. Real fact → 儘管 / 雖然.

exercises.answer: Environmental protection is getting more and more important
acceptableAnswers: Environmentalism is more important than ever

lessons.title: Register switch
lessons.description: Casual or formal?

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is FORMAL?
options: 尊敬的李總，請問您何時方便？
exercises.answer: 尊敬的李總，請問您何時方便？

exercises.prompt: casual to formal again
Which is the right closing for a business email?
Your boss WeChats you about a deadline. Pick the appropriate reply:
exercises.explanation: Workplace casual-formal: 好的 + complete sentence. The other options are too casual for boss communication.

exercises.prompt: Your friend WeChats you the same question. Pick the appropriate reply:
options: 敬請放心，必將按期完成
我謹代表自己保證完成
exercises.explanation: Friend = casual register: 好嘞, 沒問題. The formal options would be jarringly stiff between friends.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual to formal: "現在 沒什麼時間，因為 太忙了" → formal version
exercises.answer: 目前 沒 有 太 多 時間 由於 工作 繁忙
exercises.explanation: 現在→目前, 因為→由於, 太忙了→工作繁忙. Each swap raises the register a level.

exercises.prompt: casual to formal sentence-pair
Casual: 你好啊！ → Formal email opener: ___
exercises.explanation: Strip the 啊 particle and swap 你 → 您. The exclamation is optional in formal writing.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual 都怪我，我來背鍋 to a formal version. The blank fills: "___ 願意 為此 承擔 全部 責任"
exercises.explanation: 本人 (formal first-person) replaces casual 我 / 哥 / 我自己. 承擔 (assume) replaces 背鍋 (slang "take the blame"). 全部責任 = full responsibility.

exercises.prompt: Build a formal opening: "I am writing to thank you for your help"
exercises.answer: 我 寫 此 信 是 想 感 謝 您 的 幫助

exercises.prompt: "敬請回復" is closer in register to: ___
exercises.explanation: 敬 (respectfully) + 請 (please) + 回覆 (reply) — formal email request. Casual equivalent: 給我回個話唄 / 幫我回一下.

exercises.prompt: Tap the FORMAL connector you hear
exercises.explanation: 然而 — formal/written "however". 但是 / 可是 / 不過 are progressively more casual. Anchor delivery and essay reading favor 然而.

exercises.prompt: Build a formal opener: "I am writing this letter to thank you for your help"
exercises.answer: 我 寫 此 信 是 想 感 謝 您 的 幫助

exercises.prompt: Which is the FORMAL connector?
exercises.explanation: 然而 — formal/written "however". The others are progressively more casual.

exercises.prompt: Formal lift: casual 現在 沒 什麼 時間, 因為 太忙 了 → "___ 沒 有 太 多 時間, 由於 工作 繁忙"
exercises.explanation: 現在 → 目前 is the standard register lift.

exercises.source: 尊敬的李總，請問您何時方便？

acceptableAnswers: Dear Manager Li, when would be convenient for you?
Respected Manager Li, when are you available?

exercises.prompt: A friend WeChats you about a deadline. Pick the appropriate reply:

我謹代表自己保證完成
exercises.explanation: Casual friend chat — formal options would be jarringly stiff.

exercises.prompt: Tap the formal pronoun you hear

levels.name: C1 — Advanced
levels.description: Operate in Mandarin for business, academic, and journalistic contexts. Argue a position, structure formal discourse, and use 成語 with confidence.

topics.title: Business Chinese
topics.description: Meetings, negotiation, and formal correspondence

guide.intro: Business Mandarin lives in a register far above everyday speech. The same idea you'd say with 因為...所以 over coffee gets dressed up with 鑑於... 因此 in a meeting. Three habits define the register: connectives that tie clauses together, nominalized topics with 至於, and a default to 您 / 貴 honorifics.

sections.text: Formal causal connectives

Casual Chinese uses 因為 X 所以 Y. In formal writing and meetings, you upgrade to 鑑於 X，因此 Y ("in view of X, therefore Y") or 由於 X，故 Y ("owing to X, hence Y"). 因此 and 故 are interchangeable for "therefore", but 故 sounds bookish.

rows.source: 鑑於市場環境的變化，我們因此調整了戰略。
rows.pinyin: Jiànyú shìchǎng huánjìng de biànhuà, wǒmen yīncǐ tiáozhěng le zhànlüè.
rows.translation: In view of market changes, we have therefore adjusted our strategy.

rows.source: 由於成本上升，公司因此決定提價。
rows.pinyin: Yóuyú chéngběn shàngshēng, gōngsī yīncǐ juédìng tíjià.
rows.translation: Owing to rising costs, the company has accordingly decided to raise prices.

rows.source: 因為成本上升，所以我們漲價了。
rows.pinyin: Yīnwèi chéngběn shàngshēng, suǒyǐ wǒmen zhǎngjià le.
rows.translation: Because costs rose, we raised prices. (casual)

sections.text: 然而 vs 但是 — "however"
但是 works in any register. 然而 is the formal cousin you reach for in reports, op-eds, and presentations. 不過 sits in between — written Chinese friendly but not stiff.

rows: Strong contrast in essays, news, reports.

sections.text: 至於 — topic shift

至於 X ("as for X") moves the spotlight to a new sub-topic and is heavily used in structured talks. The phrase always introduces a fresh clause and is followed by a comma. Think of it as the spoken equivalent of a slide transition.

rows.source: 營收方面我們超出預期。至於成本，仍需進一步控制。
rows.pinyin: Yíngshōu fāngmiàn wǒmen chāochū yùqī. Zhìyú chéngběn, réng xū jìnyībù kòngzhì.
rows.translation: On revenue we exceeded expectations. As for costs, they still need to be controlled further.

rows.source: 至於您提到的合作方式，我們下週再深入討論。
rows.pinyin: Zhìyú nín tídào de hézuò fāngshì, wǒmen xiàzhōu zài shēnrù tǎolùn.
rows.translation: As for the form of cooperation you mentioned, let us discuss it in depth next week.

sections.text: 貴 — honorific prefix

貴 ("honored") attaches to nouns referring to the other party's affiliations: 貴公司 (your company), 貴校 (your school), 貴姓 (your honored surname). Use 貴 anywhere a respectful tone is owed; in return, refer to your own side with the humble 敝 (敝公司 "my humble company") or simply 我方 ("our side").
Mixing registers will make you sound off. Once you open a meeting with 貴公司, stay in formal mode: keep using 您, swap 但是 for 然而, and lean on 至於 for transitions.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch — which sentence sounds wrong because a casual word slipped into a formal opener?
options: 感謝各位撥冗出席今天的會議
感謝大家抽空來開個會

exercises.answer: 感謝各位撥冗出席這次破會
exercises.explanation: 撥冗出席 is formal; 破會 ("crap meeting") is dismissive slang. The casual second option is internally consistent; the third option mixes a stiff opener with a slur. The other two stay in register.

exercises.answer: 我認為 (current view) ≠ 我以為 (mistaken prior view)
exercises.explanation: 我以為 implies the speaker has been corrected. 我認為 is a current claim. Mishearing one for the other inverts the message.

exercises.answer: 在數量上我們可以讓步，但單價必須維持

exercises.prompt: Which sentence transforms casual "我覺得這個價格太貴了" into formal supplier-negotiation register?

exercises.answer: 我方認為該報價偏高，希望貴方能予以調整

恕 ("forgive") + 直言 ("straight talk") — formal lead-in to candid disagreement.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "恐怕這個方案我們 ___ 接受" (hard to)

exercises.prompt: Which counter-offer phrasing keeps full formal register?
options: 我方提議如下，敬請貴方斟酌
我們這邊覺得這樣可以
exercises.answer: 我方提議如下，敬請貴方斟酌

exercises.prompt: Build "Although the two sides hold differences, we hope to reach a consensus through consultation"

exercises.prompt: Tap the diplomatic rejection you hear
exercises.spokenText: 恐怕這個方案我們難以接受

exercises.answer: 恐怕這個方案我們難以接受

exercises.prompt: Complete the concession: "在數量上我們可以 ___，但單價必須維持" (yield)

exercises.prompt: Which signals a firm but polite deal-breaker?
exercises.explanation: 底線 = bottom line. The other options abdicate authority or sound dictatorial.

exercises.answer: Please allow us to think it over

lessons.title: Formal email & letters

exercises.answer: Our side will certainly elaborate in detail in next week's proposal
acceptableAnswers: we will surely set it out in detail in next week's proposal
we will elaborate in detail in next week's proposal

exercises.prompt: Which is most consistent with the board-report register?
options: 董事會需要看到具體的資料支援

exercises.prompt: Tap the concern structure you hear

options: 一方面是付款週期，另一方面則是智慧財產權歸屬
一方面是付款，另一方面是產權
一方面是智慧財產權，另一方面是付款
exercises.answer: 一方面是付款週期，另一方面則是智慧財產權歸屬
exercises.explanation: Listen for 週期 (cycle) and 歸屬 (ownership) — small content words that carry the meaning.

exercises.prompt: Pick the most polite acknowledgement of effort by the team:
exercises.explanation: 各位辛苦了 is the standard collective thanks; the rest skip register.

exercises.prompt: Complete the question: "對方對長期合作的態度是否 ___" (positive)
exercises.explanation: 積極 = positive / proactive; common in business reporting.

exercises.source: 請把附件轉發各位董事
exercises.answer: Please forward the attachment to all the board members
acceptableAnswers: please forward the attachment to each director
exercises.context: Wrap-up instruction after a board update

exercises.prompt: Which sentence properly raises a concession question in formal register?
options: 我們能否在條款上有所讓步
exercises.answer: 我們能否在條款上有所讓步

exercises.prompt: Build "As for the specific data, I have organized it into an attachment for your reference"
exercises.answer: 至於 具體 資料 ， 我 已 整理 成 附件 供 各位 參閱

exercises.prompt: Which sentence best raises a follow-up commitment in a board setting?
options: 下週提案務必把這兩點寫清楚
exercises.answer: 下週提案務必把這兩點寫清楚
exercises.explanation: 務必 = must / by all means; commits without ambiguity.

topics.title: Academic discourse
topics.description: Lectures, papers, and presenting research

guide.intro: Academic Chinese is dense, nominalized, and emphasis-heavy. Two structures dominate: 是...的 to spotlight one component of an established fact, and nominalization with 的 / 來說 / 而言 to package whole clauses as topics. Master these and your writing instantly sounds academic.

sections.text: 是...的 — emphasis on a known event

When the listener already knows the action happened and you want to highlight when, where, how, or who did it, wrap that element in 是...的. The 是 sits before the highlighted phrase; 的 closes the sentence.

rows.translation: He came. (neutral statement)
It was yesterday that he came. (when)

rows.pinyin: Tā shì cóng Běijīng lái de.
rows.translation: It is from Beijing that he came. (where)

rows.pinyin: Zhè běn shū shì èr líng yī bā nián chūbǎn de.
rows.translation: This book was published in 2018. (focus on the year)

sections.text: 是...的 only works for events the listener already accepts as fact. If you're announcing fresh news, use 了 instead — 是...的 would sound oddly defensive.
Nominalization with 的話 / 來說 / 而言

Academic writing turns clauses into topic NPs. 對 X 來說 / 對 X 而言 means "as far as X is concerned". 就 X 而言 raises the formality further. These structures let you front a scoped premise before delivering an argument.

rows.source: 對發展中國家來說，氣候變化是巨大的挑戰。
rows.pinyin: Duì fāzhǎn zhōng guójiā lái shuō, qìhòu biànhuà shì jùdà de tiǎozhàn.
rows.translation: For developing countries, climate change is a huge challenge.

rows.source: 就經濟效益而言，這個方案最為合理。
rows.pinyin: Jiù jīngjì xiàoyì ér yán, zhège fāng'àn zuì wéi hélǐ.
rows.translation: In terms of economic benefit, this plan is the most reasonable.

rows.source: 如果按這個標準的話，我們都不合格。
rows.pinyin: Rúguǒ àn zhège biāozhǔn de huà, wǒmen dōu bù hégé.
rows.translation: If we go by this standard, none of us qualify.

sections.text: Hedging your claims
Academic Chinese hedges constantly. 似乎 (it seems), 可能 (possibly), 在一定程度上 (to a certain extent), and 總的來說 (generally speaking) are the four pillars. Stack them to soften strong claims.
Citing and quoting

rows.translation: According to Professor Wang's research…
As scholars have pointed out…

rows.source: 資料顯示，過去十年間增長了百分之四十。
rows.pinyin: Shùjù xiǎnshì, guòqù shí nián jiān zēngzhǎng le bǎi fēn zhī sìshí.
rows.translation: The data show that over the past decade it grew by 40%.

lessons.title: 是...的 emphasis
lessons.description: Highlight when, where, or how something happened

exercises.prompt: 她是去年從英國回來的
exercises.hint: What does this 是…的 sentence emphasize?
options: When and where she returned from
exercises.answer: When and where she returned from
exercises.explanation: 是...的 highlights the time (去年) and origin (從英國); the listener already knows she returned.

exercises.prompt: Build "This theory was first proposed by Einstein"
exercises.answer: 這個 理論 是 愛因斯坦 最早 提出 的

exercises.prompt: Pick the correct emphasis sentence for "It was in 1949 that the People's Republic was founded."
options: 中華人民共和國是1949年成立的
中華人民共和國1949年成立了
中華人民共和國成立1949年
中華人民共和國是1949年成立
exercises.answer: 中華人民共和國是1949年成立的
exercises.explanation: 是...的 frames 1949 as the focused year; the other options either drop 是, drop 的, or scramble the word order.

exercises.prompt: Pick the correct word: "這篇論文 ___ 王教授寫的" (focus: who wrote it)
exercises.explanation: 是...的 fronts "by Professor Wang" as the focus. 被 would create a passive but mismatch with 的; 把 needs a disposed object after it; 在 marks location, not agent focus.

exercises.prompt: Build "This phenomenon was first discovered in the 19th century"
exercises.answer: 這 一 現象 是 在 十九 世紀 首次 被 發現 的

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "她昨天回來了" into 是...的 emphasis (focus on the time):
exercises.explanation: 是 sits before the highlighted time; 的 closes the sentence. The other options break the frame.

exercises.prompt: the 是...的 sentence to what it emphasizes
Complete with the missing 的 closer: "該理論是上世紀七十年代提出 ___"
exercises.explanation: 是...的 always closes with 的 — a common omission error.

exercises.prompt: Tap the focus you hear
exercises.explanation: 美 vs 英 is a one-tone listening swap. 是...的 vs 了 changes whether the sentence is emphasis-frame or fresh report.

exercises.prompt: Build the formal academic line "This finding was published in Nature last year"
exercises.answer: 這 一 發現 是 去年 在 《 自然 》 雜誌 上 發表 的

exercises.prompt: Which version is correct emphasis for "It was Einstein who first proposed this theory"?
options: 這一理論是愛因斯坦最早提出的
愛因斯坦最早提出這一理論了
這一理論由愛因斯坦提出過
exercises.answer: 這一理論是愛因斯坦最早提出的
exercises.explanation: 是...的 frames 愛因斯坦 + 最早 as the focus. The other forms either drop 是/的 or scramble word order.

exercises.source: 這一理論是愛因斯坦最早提出的
exercises.answer: This theory was first proposed by Einstein
acceptableAnswers: it was einstein who first proposed this theory
einstein was the one who first proposed this theory
exercises.context: Attributing an academic claim with 是...的 focus
exercises.explanation: 是...的 brackets 愛因斯坦最早 as the focused information.

exercises.prompt: Complete the 是...的 frame: "該論文 ___ 上世紀七十年代發表 ___"
exercises.hint: Insert the focus particles around the year
exercises.explanation: 是...的 always bookends the focused element.

exercises.prompt: Which 是...的 sentence focuses on MEANS of arrival?
exercises.explanation: 坐高鐵 = by high-speed rail — the means/method. The others highlight time, origin, or purpose.

exercises.prompt: Build "This finding was published last year in the journal Nature"
exercises.answer: 這 一 發現 是 去年 在 自然 雜誌 上 發表 的

exercises.prompt: Tap the focused element you hear
exercises.explanation: Train your ear for 2018 vs 2008 and 出版 vs 再版; 是...的 vs 了 changes the frame.

exercises.answer: She came back from the United States
acceptableAnswers: she is the one who came back from america
it was from the us that she returned
exercises.explanation: 是...的 focuses 從美國 as the origin information.

exercises.prompt: Pick the focus mismatch — which sentence is grammatically wrong?
exercises.explanation: 是 must precede the focused phrase; 的 closes the sentence. The other options are either correct or use 了 instead.

exercises.prompt: Insert the focus marker: "這部電影 ___ 在巴黎拍攝的"
exercises.explanation: 是...的 highlights 在巴黎 as the focused location.

exercises.prompt: Build "This phenomenon was first discovered in the nineteenth century"
exercises.answer: 這 一 現象 是 在 十九 世紀 首次 被 發現 的

lessons.title: Topic framing — 對...來說
lessons.description: Scope an argument to a population or angle

exercises.prompt: Build "For young people, housing prices are unbearable"
exercises.answer: 對 年輕人 來說 ， 房價 已經 難以 承受

exercises.prompt: Which is most formal?
exercises.explanation: 對...而言 is the formal academic version of 對...來說; both go further than 我覺得.

exercises.prompt: the framing phrase

pairs.right: As far as students are concerned

exercises.prompt: Build "In terms of economic efficiency, this plan is the most reasonable"
exercises.answer: 就 經濟 效益 而言 ， 這個 方案 最為 合理

exercises.prompt: 就這一問題而言，學界尚未達成共識
exercises.hint: What does this academic line mean?
options: On this question, academia has not yet reached consensus
exercises.answer: On this question, academia has not yet reached consensus
exercises.explanation: 就...而言 frames the topic; 尚未 ("not yet") is the formal version of 還沒.

exercises.prompt: the topic-framing phrase to its register

pairs.right: Neutral, common in speech and writing

exercises.prompt: Complete the formal academic frame: "___ 發展中國家 而言，氣候變化是巨大的挑戰"
exercises.explanation: 對...而言 / 就...而言 are both correct; 對 is more common.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch:
options: 對學生而言，考試壓力非常大
對學生來說，考試壓力非常大
學生嘛，考試壓力對他們而言非常大
就學生而言，考試壓力非常大
exercises.answer: 學生嘛，考試壓力對他們而言非常大
exercises.explanation: 嘛 is colloquial filler; 而言 is formal. Mixing them sounds jarring. The other three are register-internally consistent.

exercises.prompt: Build "In the long run, education investment will yield enormous returns"
exercises.answer: 從 長遠 來看 ， 教育 投入 將 帶來 巨大 回報

exercises.prompt: Tap the framing phrase you hear
exercises.spokenText: 對年輕人而言房價已經難以承受
options: 對年輕人而言房價已經難以承受
對年輕人來說房價已經難以承受
對老年人而言房價已經難以承受
對年輕人而言房價已經可以承受
exercises.answer: 對年輕人而言房價已經難以承受
exercises.explanation: Listening at C1: 而言/來說 is register; 年輕人/老年人 is the topic; 難以/可以 inverts polarity.

exercises.source: 對發展中國家而言，氣候變化是巨大的挑戰
exercises.answer: For developing countries, climate change is a huge challenge
acceptableAnswers: as for developing countries, climate change is a great challenge
with regard to developing countries, climate change poses a huge challenge
exercises.context: Framing the scope of an argument
exercises.explanation: 對...而言 fronts the population whose perspective is being scoped.

exercises.prompt: Complete the formal frame: "___ 經濟效益 而言，這個方案最為合理" (in terms of)
exercises.explanation: 就...而言 = in terms of, slightly more technical than 對...而言.

exercises.prompt: Which is the most formal version of "in my view"?
exercises.explanation: 對我而言 is the formal academic version; the others are colloquial.

exercises.prompt: Build "From a long-term perspective, education investment will yield enormous returns"
exercises.answer: 從 長遠 來看 ， 教育 投入 將 帶來 巨大 回報

exercises.prompt: Tap the academic frame you hear
exercises.spokenText: 就這一問題而言學界尚未達成共識
options: 就這一問題而言學界尚未達成共識
對這一問題來說學界尚未達成共識
就這一問題而言學界已經達成共識
就此問題而言學界尚未達成共識
exercises.answer: 就這一問題而言學界尚未達成共識
exercises.explanation: Listen for 就/對, 而言/來說, 尚未/已經 — each carries register or polarity.
在一定程度上 partially qualifies the claim that follows.

exercises.prompt: Complete the scope frame: "___ 長遠 ___ ，環保投資必將帶來回報" (from the long-term view)
exercises.hint: Two characters for the formal frame
exercises.explanation: 從...來看 brackets the perspective of analysis.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence stays formal academic register?
options: 就教育改革而言，專家意見分歧明顯
教育改革啊，專家說法不一
教改這事兒專家說啥的都有
教育改革的話大家各說各的
exercises.answer: 就教育改革而言，專家意見分歧明顯
exercises.explanation: 就...而言 + 意見分歧 + 明顯 keep formal academic register throughout.

exercises.prompt: Build "For young people, housing prices have become unbearable"
exercises.answer: 對 年輕人 而言 ， 房價 已 難以 承受

lessons.title: Citing & paraphrasing
lessons.description: Bring sources into your argument

exercises.prompt: the citation phrase
Build "The data show that population is rising year by year"
exercises.answer: 資料 表明 ， 人口 正在 逐年 上升

exercises.prompt: 眾所周知 (zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī)
exercises.hint: What does this academic opener mean?
options: It is well known to all
exercises.answer: It is well known to all
exercises.explanation: Literally "what the masses all know" — a fixed academic opener.

exercises.prompt: Tap the connective you hear
exercises.spokenText: 因此我們得出以下結論
options: 因此我們得出以下結論
由此我們得出以下結論
因為我們得出以下結論
於是我們得出以下結論
exercises.answer: 因此我們得出以下結論
exercises.explanation: 因此 ("therefore") and 由此 ("from this") both link cause to result, but 因此 fronts the conclusion while 由此 fronts the inference path. Train your ear to catch the difference.

exercises.prompt: the citation style to its function
Pick the most academic phrasing for "according to the latest research":
exercises.explanation: 根據 ("based on") + 研究 + neutral nominalization is the academic standard. The others are casual or hedged.

exercises.prompt: Build "As Professor Wang has pointed out, this view warrants further investigation"
exercises.answer: 正如 王 教授 所 指出 的 ， 這 一 觀點 值得 進一步 研究

exercises.prompt: Peer-review hedge: "該論文 ___ 一定的創新性，但論證仍可加強" (has a certain degree of)
exercises.explanation: 具有/具備一定的 X 是 standard peer-review hedge — you grant a degree without overstating.

exercises.prompt: 該研究為後續工作奠定了基礎
exercises.hint: What does this academic line mean?
options: This research lays the foundation for follow-up work
exercises.answer: This research lays the foundation for follow-up work
exercises.explanation: 奠定基礎 = lay the foundation — fixed academic praise.

exercises.prompt: Build "The data show that over the past decade urbanization has accelerated significantly"
exercises.answer: 資料 表明 ， 過去 十年 間 城市化 程序 顯著 加快

acceptableAnswers: based on the most recent research
exercises.explanation: 根據 = based on / according to.

exercises.prompt: Complete the academic opener: "___ 表明，過去十年間城市化程序顯著加快" (data show)
exercises.explanation: 資料表明 / 研究表明 — fixed openers; 資料 is more empirical.

exercises.prompt: Which line frames a direct quotation in academic register?
exercises.explanation: 引用...原話 is the standard citation framing; the others are recollective and casual.

exercises.prompt: Build "As scholars have pointed out, this view warrants further investigation"
exercises.answer: 正如 學者 所 指出 的 ， 這 一 觀點 值得 進一步 研究

exercises.prompt: Tap the academic citation phrase you hear
exercises.spokenText: 眾所周知教育是社會流動的重要途徑
options: 眾所周知教育是社會流動的重要途徑
據說教育是社會流動的重要途徑
眾所周知教育是社會流動的唯一途徑
大家都知道教育對社會流動重要
exercises.answer: 眾所周知教育是社會流動的重要途徑
exercises.explanation: 眾所周知 vs 據說 marks degree of acceptance; 重要/唯一 changes the strength of the claim.
資料 = data; 表明 = show / demonstrate.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "該論文 ___ 一定的創新性，但論證仍可加強" (has a certain degree of)
exercises.explanation: 具有 / 具備一定的 X is a standard peer-review hedge.

exercises.prompt: 該研究為後續工作奠定了基礎
exercises.hint: What does this peer-review phrase mean?
options: This research lays the foundation for follow-up work
This research depends on earlier work
exercises.answer: This research lays the foundation for follow-up work
exercises.explanation: 奠定基礎 ("lay the foundation") is a fixed academic compliment.

exercises.prompt: Build "According to the latest research, urbanization has accelerated significantly over the past decade"
exercises.answer: 根據 最新 研究 ， 過去 十年 間 城市化 程序 顯著 加快

lessons.title: Hedging & qualifying
lessons.description: Soften claims like a careful scholar

exercises.prompt: Which phrase hedges a generalization the most?
exercises.explanation: 在一定程度上 ("to a certain extent") signals a partial / qualified claim.

exercises.prompt: Build "This phenomenon seems to be related to climate change"
exercises.answer: 這 一 現象 似乎 與 氣候 變化 有關

exercises.prompt: the hedge to its function
Which sentence is the most cautious academic claim?
options: 結果絕對證明氣候變化加速
結果在一定程度上表明氣候變化可能加速
結果表明氣候變化加速
結果說明氣候變化必然加速
exercises.answer: 結果在一定程度上表明氣候變化可能加速
exercises.explanation: 在一定程度上 + 可能 stacks two hedges. 絕對/必然/必將 over-claim; 表明 alone is moderate.

exercises.prompt: Build "Generally speaking, this approach has some validity"
exercises.answer: 總的 來說 ， 這種 方法 在 一定 程度 上 是 有效 的

exercises.prompt: the hedge to its strength
Pick the near-synonym distinction:
options: 我深信 (firm conviction) > 我認為 (current view) > 我以為 (mistaken prior)
exercises.answer: 我深信 (firm conviction) > 我認為 (current view) > 我以為 (mistaken prior)
exercises.explanation: Strength gradient: 我深信 (deeply believe) > 我堅信 ≈ 我認為 > 我覺得 > 我以為 (was mistaken). Mishearing flips the message.

exercises.prompt: Tap the hedged claim you hear
exercises.spokenText: 這一現象似乎與氣候變化有關
options: 這一現象似乎與氣候變化有關
這一現象肯定與氣候變化有關
這一現象似乎與氣候變化無關
這一現象一定與氣候變化有關
exercises.answer: 這一現象似乎與氣候變化有關
exercises.explanation: 似乎/肯定/一定 sit at very different hedge levels. 有關/無關 inverts polarity.

exercises.prompt: Build "To a certain extent, this view has its rationale, but it still needs further verification"
exercises.answer: 在 一定 程度 上 ， 這 一 觀點 有 其 道理 ， 但 仍 需 進一步 驗證

exercises.prompt: Soften the strong claim: "該方案絕對可行" → "該方案 ___ 可行" (in a certain way)
exercises.explanation: 或許/可能/似乎/在一定程度上 all soften the assertion.

exercises.source: 結果在一定程度上表明氣候變化可能加速
exercises.answer: The results to a certain extent suggest that climate change may be accelerating
acceptableAnswers: the results suggest to some degree that climate change might be accelerating
results indicate to a certain extent that climate change may be speeding up
exercises.explanation: 在一定程度上 + 可能 + 表明 stacks three hedges.

exercises.prompt: Hedge the strong claim: "該方案絕對可行" → "該方案 ___ 可行" (perhaps)
exercises.explanation: 或許/可能/也許 all soften 絕對.

exercises.prompt: Which hedge is strongest?
exercises.explanation: 毫無疑問 ("without a doubt") is a strong-claim opener; the others are soft to medium.

exercises.prompt: Build "To a certain extent, this view has its rationale, but it still requires further verification"
exercises.answer: 在 一定 程度 上 ， 這 一 觀點 有 其 道理 ， 但 仍 需 進一步 驗證

exercises.prompt: Tap the hedged claim you hear

lessons.title: 由此可見 / 不難看出 — drawing inferences
lessons.description: Lead the reader to your conclusion

exercises.prompt: 由此可見 (yóu cǐ kě jiàn)

options: From this we can see / it follows that
exercises.answer: From this we can see / it follows that
exercises.explanation: 由此可見 hands the reader a conclusion drawn from the evidence just presented.

exercises.prompt: the inference phrase

pairs.right: From this it can be seen
It is not hard to see

布林迪厄那個習慣概念挺好用的
我覺得布林迪厄這個想法對
布林迪厄的概念我比較喜歡
exercises.answer: 布林迪厄之慣習概念更契合青年群體之實踐邏輯
exercises.explanation: 之 + 契合 + 實踐邏輯 are formal academic markers.

exercises.prompt: Build "The reason this research adopts a three-hundred-person sample is because it emphasizes in-depth interviews"
exercises.answer: 本 研究 之所以 採用 三百 人 樣本 ， 是 因為 側重 深度 訪談

exercises.prompt: Tap the formal research-purpose statement you hear
exercises.spokenText: 本研究旨在揭示社交媒體對青年價值觀的形塑作用
options: 本研究旨在揭示社交媒體對青年價值觀的形塑作用
我這篇論文想說社交媒體的影響
我研究的是社交媒體對青年的作用
本研究旨在掩蓋社交媒體對青年價值觀的形塑作用
exercises.answer: 本研究旨在揭示社交媒體對青年價值觀的形塑作用
exercises.explanation: 揭示 (reveal) vs 掩蓋 (cover up) inverts the academic stance.

exercises.prompt: Which line best opens a thesis defense?
options: 請先簡述本研究的核心論點及其學術意義
你這個論文寫得怎麼樣
exercises.answer: 請先簡述本研究的核心論點及其學術意義
exercises.explanation: 請先簡述 + 核心論點 + 學術意義 are formal committee-grade phrasing.

exercises.prompt: Complete the formal pivot: "主觀性確實難以避免，___ 本研究通過三角驗證以增強信度" (however)
exercises.explanation: 然而 is the formal academic version of 但是.

exercises.source: 本研究的核心論點及其學術意義
exercises.answer: The core argument of this research and its academic significance
acceptableAnswers: the central thesis of this study and its academic importance
this research's main argument and its scholarly significance
exercises.context: Opening prompt of a thesis defense
exercises.explanation: 及其 = and its; 學術意義 = academic significance.

exercises.prompt: Build "Interviews, questionnaires and journals mutually corroborate; their results have high consistency"
exercises.answer: 訪談 、 問卷 與 日誌 三者 互證 ， 其 結果 具有 較 高 一致性

exercises.prompt: Which sentence uses the formal possessive 其 correctly?
exercises.explanation: 及其 (its / and its) is the formal literary pairing; 它的 is colloquial.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "布林迪厄之慣習概念更 ___ 青年群體之實踐邏輯" (matches / fits)
exercises.explanation: 契合 = align with / fit closely — formal academic register.

exercises.prompt: Tap the methodology justification you hear
exercises.spokenText: 本研究之所以採用三百人樣本是因為側重深度訪談
options: 本研究之所以採用三百人樣本是因為側重深度訪談
本研究採用三百人樣本是因為時間不夠
本研究之所以採用三百人樣本是因為側重數量分析
本研究用了三百人樣本因為方便
exercises.answer: 本研究之所以採用三百人樣本是因為側重深度訪談
exercises.explanation: 之所以...是因為... pairs with 深度訪談; the variants either drop register or change the reason.

exercises.source: 委員會將另行通知評議結果
exercises.answer: The committee will separately notify you of the evaluation results
acceptableAnswers: the committee will separately inform you of the review outcome
the committee will provide a separate notice of the review result
exercises.context: Closing line of a thesis defense
exercises.explanation: 另行通知 = separately notify; 評議 = review / evaluation.

exercises.prompt: Build "Bourdieu's habitus concept fits the practical logic of the youth group better"
exercises.answer: 布林迪厄 之 慣習 概念 更 契合 青年 群體 之 實踐 邏輯
