lessons.title: Urbanization
lessons.description: Migration, megacities, and growing pains

exercises.prompt: the term to its meaning
Build "Urbanization has brought enormous economic benefits"
exercises.answer: 城市化 給 經濟 帶來 了 巨大 的 好處

exercises.prompt: 大城市的房價居高不下
exercises.hint: What does this social-issue line mean?
options: Big-city housing prices remain stubbornly high
Houses are cheap in big cities
exercises.answer: Big-city housing prices remain stubbornly high
exercises.explanation: 居高不下 is a fixed expression meaning "stay high and not come down".

exercises.prompt: What does "城鄉差距" describe?
exercises.explanation: 城鄉 (cheng-xiang) = urban-rural; 差距 = gap.

exercises.prompt: Build "In view of the problems brought by urbanization, the government has rolled out a series of policies"
exercises.answer: 鑑於 城市化 帶來 的 問題 ， 政府 出臺 了 一 系列 政策

exercises.prompt: the urbanization-discourse term
Tap the headline you hear
exercises.explanation: Listening for fixed expressions: 居高不下 vs 持續下降 inverts the trend; 房價 vs 房租 changes the topic.

exercises.prompt: Pick the editorial-grade phrasing for "the wealth gap continues to widen":
options: 貧富差距正在持續擴大
窮人和富人差距越來越大
有錢的越有錢沒錢的越沒錢
exercises.answer: 貧富差距正在持續擴大
exercises.explanation: 貧富差距 + 持續擴大 = formal editorial register. The others are conversational.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "___ 而言，戶口制度對勞動力流動構成了限制" (in terms of social mobility, ...)
exercises.explanation: 就...而言 fronts the topic; 戶口制度 = household registration system.

exercises.prompt: Build "Although urbanization brings opportunities, it also gives rise to a series of problems"
exercises.answer: 城市化 雖然 帶來 機遇 ， 但 也 引發 了 一 系列 問題

exercises.source: 貧富差距正在持續擴大
exercises.answer: The wealth gap is continuing to widen
acceptableAnswers: the gap between rich and poor keeps widening
the wealth disparity is steadily growing
exercises.explanation: 貧富 (rich and poor) + 差距 (gap) + 持續擴大 (continue to widen).

exercises.prompt: Complete: "大城市的房價 ___" (remain stubbornly high)
exercises.explanation: 居高不下 = stay high without coming down — fixed editorial idiom.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence best frames a policy response in formal register?
options: 鑑於城市化帶來的問題，政府出臺了一系列政策
城市化有問題政府就趕緊出政策
城市化挺亂的政府得管管
exercises.answer: 鑑於城市化帶來的問題，政府出臺了一系列政策
exercises.explanation: 鑑於 + 一系列政策 = formal cause-response framing.

exercises.prompt: Build "Although urbanization brings opportunities, it also gives rise to a series of problems"
exercises.answer: 城市化 雖 帶來 機遇 ， 但 也 引發 了 一 系列 問題

exercises.prompt: Tap the urban-rural term you hear
exercises.spokenText: 城鄉差距正在持續擴大
options: 城鄉差距正在持續擴大
貧富差距正在持續擴大
城鄉差距正在持續縮小
城鄉矛盾正在持續擴大
exercises.answer: 城鄉差距正在持續擴大
exercises.explanation: Listen for 城鄉/貧富, 差距/矛盾, and 擴大/縮小.

exercises.source: 戶口制度對勞動力流動構成了限制
exercises.answer: The household registration system has constrained labor mobility
acceptableAnswers: the hukou system has restricted labor mobility
the household registration system imposes limits on labor mobility
exercises.context: Editorial framing of a structural constraint
exercises.explanation: 戶口制度 = hukou system; 構成限制 = constitute a limitation.

exercises.prompt: Complete the editorial frame: "___ 流動人口而言，城市歸屬感仍較薄弱" (in terms of)
exercises.explanation: 就...而言 / 對...而言 frame the affected population.

exercises.prompt: 城中村 (chéng zhōng cūn)
exercises.hint: What does this urban-issue term mean?
exercises.explanation: 城 (city) 中 (within) 村 (village) — a village engulfed by urban expansion.

exercises.prompt: Build "In view of inadequate infrastructure, the government must increase investment"
exercises.answer: 鑑於 基礎 設施 不足 ， 政府 必須 加大 投入

lessons.title: Aging society
lessons.description: Demographics, retirement, and care

exercises.prompt: the demographic term
少子化 (shǎo zǐ huà)
exercises.hint: What does this demographic term mean?
exercises.explanation: Coined from Japanese, becoming common in Chinese policy discussions; mainland writing still tends toward 出生率下降.

exercises.prompt: Build "China's population is aging rapidly"
exercises.answer: 中國 的 人口 正在 快速 老齡化

exercises.prompt: 延遲退休年齡
exercises.hint: What does this policy term mean?
exercises.explanation: 延遲 = delay; 退休年齡 = retirement age. A common policy response to aging.

exercises.prompt: Build "In view of the rapid aging of the population, the government must reform the pension system"
exercises.answer: 鑑於 人口 老齡化 加速 ， 政府 必須 改革 養老 制度

exercises.prompt: the aging-society term
Tap the demographic statistic you hear
exercises.spokenText: 六十五歲以上人口已達百分之十八
options: 六十五歲以上人口已達百分之十八
六十五歲以上人口已達百分之八
七十五歲以上人口已達百分之十八
六十歲以上人口已達百分之十八
exercises.answer: 六十五歲以上人口已達百分之十八
exercises.explanation: C1 listening at numeric precision: 六十五/七十五/六十; 十八/八.

exercises.prompt: Pick the editorial register for "the birth rate has fallen to a record low":
options: 出生率已降至歷史新低
exercises.answer: 出生率已降至歷史新低
exercises.explanation: 降至歷史新低 = fall to a historic low — fixed editorial collocation.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "老齡化對經濟社會的影響 ___" (cannot be ignored)
exercises.explanation: 不容忽視 (literally "cannot tolerate being ignored") is the editorial standby for serious problems.

exercises.prompt: Build "It is not hard to see that, in the long run, an aging society will reshape consumption patterns"
exercises.answer: 不難 看出 ， 從 長遠 來看 ， 老齡化 社會 將 重塑 消費 模式

exercises.source: 老齡化對經濟社會的影響不容忽視
exercises.answer: The impact of aging on the economy and society cannot be ignored
acceptableAnswers: the effect of aging on economy and society cannot be overlooked
aging's impact on society and the economy must not be ignored
exercises.explanation: 不容忽視 = cannot be overlooked; standard editorial intensifier.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "出生率已降至 ___" (a historic low)
exercises.explanation: 降至歷史新低 = fall to a historic low — fixed editorial collocation.

exercises.prompt: Which pair correctly matches policy and intent?
options: 延遲退休年齡 — extend working life
延遲退休年齡 — lower the retirement threshold
延遲退休年齡 — abolish pensions
延遲退休年齡 — encourage early exit from work
exercises.answer: 延遲退休年齡 — extend working life
exercises.explanation: Delaying retirement age keeps people working longer to ease pension pressure.

exercises.prompt: Build "In view of the rapid aging of the population, the government must reform the pension system"
exercises.answer: 鑑於 人口 老齡化 加速 ， 政府 必須 改革 養老 制度

exercises.prompt: Tap the aging-society term you hear
exercises.spokenText: 空巢老人數量持續上升
options: 空巢老人數量持續上升
獨居老人數量持續上升
空巢老人數量持續下降
空巢家庭數量持續上升
exercises.answer: 空巢老人數量持續上升
exercises.explanation: Listen for 空巢/獨居 (empty-nest/lone-dwelling), 老人/家庭 (elderly/households), and 上升/下降.
銀髮 = silver hair; 經濟 = economy — products and services for seniors.

exercises.prompt: Complete the editorial frame: "中國的人口 ___ 快速老齡化" (currently)
exercises.explanation: 正在 V = currently V-ing; common in editorial prose.

exercises.prompt: 老有所養 (lǎo yǒu suǒ yǎng)
exercises.hint: What does this four-character idiom mean?
exercises.explanation: Literally "the old have something to be supported by" — a Confucian social ideal.

exercises.prompt: Build "In the long run, an aging society will reshape consumption patterns"
exercises.answer: 從 長遠 來看 ， 老齡化 社會 將 重塑 消費 模式

lessons.title: Environment & climate
lessons.description: Pollution, policy, and sustainability

exercises.prompt: the environmental term
Build "The government has issued new environmental protection policies"
exercises.answer: 政府 出臺 了 新 的 環保 政策

exercises.prompt: 綠水青山就是金山銀山
options: Clear waters and green mountains are mountains of gold and silver (i.e. environment is wealth)
exercises.answer: Clear waters and green mountains are mountains of gold and silver (i.e. environment is wealth)
exercises.explanation: A famous policy slogan equating ecological wealth with economic wealth.

exercises.prompt: 減排 (jiǎn pái)
exercises.hint: What does this environmental term mean?
exercises.explanation: 減 (reduce) + 排 (emit) — abbreviation for 減少排放.

exercises.prompt: Build "Although clean energy costs are higher, in the long run it is the only way out"
exercises.answer: 雖然 清潔 能源 成本 較 高 ， 但 從 長遠 來看 是 唯一 出路

exercises.prompt: the climate-policy idiom
Tap the policy slogan you hear
exercises.spokenText: 綠水青山就是金山銀山
options: 綠水青山就是金山銀山
綠水青山可以變成金山銀山
金山銀山就是綠水青山
綠水青山好過金山銀山
exercises.answer: 綠水青山就是金山銀山
exercises.explanation: Listening for fixed slogan structure: 就是 vs 可以變成 vs 好過 — small swaps reshape the meaning.

exercises.prompt: Pick the editorial-grade phrasing for "climate action brooks no delay":
options: 應對氣候變化刻不容緩
氣候變化要趕緊做點什麼
exercises.answer: 應對氣候變化刻不容緩
exercises.explanation: 應對 + 刻不容緩 = strong editorial register. The others slip into colloquial.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "實現碳中和 ___，但意義重大" (the road is long)
exercises.explanation: 任重道遠 — "the burden is heavy and the road is long" — frames a long-term mission.

exercises.prompt: Build "It is well known that climate change is a challenge faced by all of humanity together"
exercises.answer: 眾所周知 ， 氣候 變化 是 全 人類 共同 面臨 的 挑戰

exercises.source: 應對氣候變化刻不容緩
exercises.answer: Addressing climate change brooks no delay
acceptableAnswers: acting on climate change cannot wait
responding to climate change is urgent
exercises.explanation: 應對 = address / respond to; 刻不容緩 = brooks no delay.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "實現碳中和 ___ ，但意義重大" (heavy burden, long road)
exercises.explanation: 任重道遠 frames an arduous long-term mission.

exercises.prompt: 可持續發展 (kě chí xù fā zhǎn)
exercises.hint: What does this policy term mean?
exercises.explanation: 可持續 (sustainable) + 發展 (development) — UN-era policy borrowing.

exercises.prompt: Build "Although clean energy costs are higher, in the long run it is the only way out"
exercises.answer: 雖然 清潔 能源 成本 較 高 ， 但 從 長遠 來看 是 唯一 出路

exercises.prompt: Tap the environmental term you hear
exercises.explanation: Listen for 霧霾/沙塵 (smog/dust), 天氣/警報 (weather/alert), and 出現/消失.
可 (able) + 再生 (regenerate) + 能源 (energy).

exercises.prompt: Complete: "氣候變化是全人類共同 ___ 的挑戰" (face)
exercises.explanation: 面臨 (face / be confronted with) is more formal than 面對.

exercises.prompt: 防患未然 (fáng huàn wèi rán)
exercises.explanation: 防 (guard against) + 患 (calamity) + 未然 (not yet happened).

exercises.prompt: Build "It is well known that climate change is a challenge faced by all of humanity together"
exercises.answer: 眾所周知 ， 氣候 變化 是 全 人類 共同 面臨 的 挑戰

lessons.title: Education & inequality
lessons.description: Schools, exams, and access

exercises.prompt: the education term
內卷 (nèi juǎn)
exercises.hint: What does this social-media buzzword describe?
exercises.explanation: 內卷 ("involution") is the modern buzzword for over-competition that yields no real progress.

exercises.prompt: Build "Educational resource distribution is still uneven"
exercises.answer: 教育 資源 的 分配 仍然 不 均衡

exercises.prompt: "寒門難出貴子" laments that it is hard for ___ families to produce successful children
exercises.explanation: 寒門 = "cold gate" — a humble household; a recurring social issue refrain.

exercises.prompt: 雙減政策
exercises.hint: What does this policy name refer to?
exercises.explanation: 雙減 = "two reductions" — the 2021 policy reducing homework load and after-school tutoring.

exercises.prompt: Build "In view of the seriousness of educational inequality, reform brooks no delay"
exercises.answer: 鑑於 教育 不 平等 的 嚴重性 ， 改革 刻不容緩

exercises.prompt: the social-mobility term
Tap the term you hear
exercises.explanation: Listen for 資源/成本/機會 (resources/cost/opportunity) and 不均/均衡 (uneven/even).

exercises.prompt: Pick the right idiom for "a humble family producing a successful child":
exercises.explanation: 寒門 (humble) + 貴子 (noble son) — a child who rises despite humble origins.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "對農村學生 ___，進入名校仍十分困難" (in terms of)
exercises.explanation: 對...而言 / 對...來說 frames the affected population.

exercises.prompt: Build "From this it can be seen that excessive competition has done little to improve overall educational quality"
exercises.answer: 由此 可見 ， 過度 競爭 對 整體 教育 質量 提升 幫助 甚 微

exercises.source: 教育資源的分配仍然不均衡
exercises.answer: The distribution of educational resources remains uneven

educational resources are still unevenly distributed
exercises.explanation: 分配 (distribution) + 不均衡 (uneven).

exercises.prompt: Complete: "鑑於教育不平等的嚴重性，改革 ___" (brooks no delay)
exercises.explanation: 刻不容緩 = brooks no delay; intensifies the urgency of reform.

exercises.prompt: Which line best critiques excessive competition in formal register?
options: 過度競爭對整體教育質量提升幫助甚微
exercises.answer: 過度競爭對整體教育質量提升幫助甚微
exercises.explanation: 過度競爭 + 幫助甚微 — formal editorial register; the others are colloquial.

exercises.prompt: Build "From this it can be seen that excessive competition has little effect on improving overall educational quality"
exercises.answer: 由此 可見 ， 過度 競爭 對 整體 教育 質量 提升 幫助 甚 微

exercises.spokenText: 雙減政策旨在減輕學業負擔
options: 雙減政策旨在減輕學業負擔
雙減政策旨在增加學業負擔
雙減政策旨在減輕經濟負擔

階層 (class) + 固化 (solidify / freeze).

exercises.prompt: Complete: "對農村學生 ___，進入名校仍十分困難" (in terms of)

guide.intro: Classical Chinese threads through modern writing in three little words: 之, 其, 所. They look intimidating but they're not new grammar — they're compressed forms of structures you already know. Recognize them and most literary and academic Chinese opens up.

sections.text: 之 — the literary 的
之 (zhī) is what 的 used to be. In modern Chinese it survives in fixed expressions and titles. Wherever you see 之, mentally substitute 的. The structure 名詞 + 之 + 名詞 = "X's Y" or "Y of X".

rows.translation: The beauty of China (= 中國的美)
The path to success
All in all ("to sum up and speak of it")

rows.pinyin: Yì jǔ liǎng dé zhī shì
rows.translation: Something that kills two birds with one stone

sections.text: 其 — "its / their / his / her"
其 (qí) is the literary third-person possessive — equivalent to 它的 / 他的 / 她的 / 他們的, depending on context. You'll meet it in essays, instructions, and idioms.

rows.translation: Its (the) result is shocking.
The company and its employees
Especially ("particularly its [case]")
Each takes what they need

sections.text: 所 — turning verbs into nouns

所 (suǒ) sits before a verb to nominalize the object: 所 + 動詞 = "that which is V-ed". The full pattern is often 名詞 + 所 + 動詞 + 的 + 名詞 = "the X that N V's". It feels ancient but appears constantly in titles and formal speech.

rows.translation: What I have seen (literally: that which I saw)
The efforts we have made
As is universally known
As reason dictates / naturally

sections.text: You almost never need to write 之/其/所 yourself in everyday Chinese. The goal is recognition: when you see 其, your brain swaps in 它的; when you see 所...的, you read it as "the thing that is V-ed".

topics.title: News & journalism
topics.description: Read headlines, parse op-eds, follow current events

guide.intro: News Chinese is its own dialect — short, dense, and heavy with cause-effect connectives. Two patterns dominate explanatory writing: 之所以 X 是因為 Y for reverse-order causation, and 不僅 X 而且 Y for stacking points. Get fluent in these and headlines stop being puzzles.

sections.text: 之所以...是因為 — effect first, cause second

Standard order is 因為 X 所以 Y ("because X, so Y"). When you want to lead with the surprising effect and explain it after, flip to 之所以 Y 是因為 X ("the reason Y is because X"). It's a hallmark of essay and op-ed Chinese.

rows.source: 他之所以成功，是因為他從不放棄。
rows.pinyin: Tā zhī suǒ yǐ chénggōng, shì yīnwèi tā cóng bù fàngqì.
rows.translation: The reason he succeeded is that he never gave up.

rows.source: 中國之所以發展迅速，是因為改革開放的政策。
rows.pinyin: Zhōngguó zhī suǒ yǐ fāzhǎn xùnsù, shì yīnwèi gǎigé kāifàng de zhèngcè.
rows.translation: China developed rapidly because of the reform and opening-up policy.

sections.text: 不僅...而且 — "not only... but also"
不僅 X 而且 Y stacks points: not only X, but also Y. The formal form is 不但 X 而且 Y; the literary form 不僅...更 ramps up the second clause.

rows.source: 這部電影不僅獲得了好評，而且票房火爆。
rows.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng bùjǐn huòdé le hǎopíng, érqiě piàofáng huǒbào.
rows.translation: This film not only got good reviews but also did huge box office.

rows.source: 他不僅是一位作家，更是一位思想家。
rows.pinyin: Tā bùjǐn shì yí wèi zuòjiā, gèng shì yí wèi sīxiǎngjiā.
rows.translation: He is not only a writer but, even more so, a thinker.

sections.text: Headline grammar
Headlines compress hard. They drop pronouns, particles, and even verbs. Learn these high-frequency journalist verbs and you'll skim headlines in seconds.
據 X 報道 — quick refresher

You met 據報道 at B2, so this is a refresher rather than new ground. At C1, focus on the variants: 據 X 報道 attributes to a named source, while 據悉 ("it is learned") is the unsourced, slightly official cousin. Both anchor the start of a sentence.

rows.source: 據新華社報道，會議將於下週舉行。
rows.pinyin: Jù Xīnhuáshè bàodào, huìyì jiāng yú xiàzhōu jǔxíng.
rows.translation: According to Xinhua News Agency, the meeting will be held next week.

rows.source: 據悉，相關部門正在調查此事。
rows.pinyin: Jù xī, xiāngguān bùmén zhèngzài diàochá cǐ shì.
rows.translation: It is learned that the relevant departments are investigating the matter.

exercises.explanation: 之所以...是因為... — formal effect-then-cause frame.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence properly cites international experience?
options: 據歐盟資料所示，碳定價十年間使排放下降約百分之二十
歐盟那邊排放降了百分之二十吧大概
exercises.answer: 據歐盟資料所示，碳定價十年間使排放下降約百分之二十
exercises.explanation: 據...所示 + 約 + 百分之 = formal data-citation register.

exercises.prompt: Build "This claim is not without merit; however, the policy is paired with subsidies to ease the burden on low-income families"
exercises.answer: 此 說 不 無 道理 ， 然而 政策 已 配套 補貼 機制 以 緩解 低 收入 家庭 負擔

exercises.prompt: Which sentence best frames the cost-time tension faced by enterprises?
options: 轉型成本高昂，而時間視窗有限，是企業面臨的雙重壓力
改造太貴了，時間也沒多少
exercises.answer: 轉型成本高昂，而時間視窗有限，是企業面臨的雙重壓力
exercises.explanation: 轉型成本 / 時間視窗 / 雙重壓力 = formal policy-analysis register.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "政策已 ___ 補貼機制以緩解低收入家庭負擔" (paired with)
exercises.explanation: 配套 = supporting / matching — fixed policy collocation.

exercises.prompt: Tap the corporate-challenge line you hear
exercises.spokenText: 轉型成本高昂而時間視窗有限是企業面臨的雙重壓力
options: 轉型成本高昂而時間視窗有限是企業面臨的雙重壓力
轉型成本低廉而時間視窗充足是企業面臨的雙重壓力
轉型成本高昂而時間充足是企業面臨的雙重機遇
轉型成本高昂而時間視窗有限是政府面臨的雙重壓力
exercises.answer: 轉型成本高昂而時間視窗有限是企業面臨的雙重壓力
exercises.explanation: Listen for 高昂/低廉, 有限/充足, 壓力/機遇, and 企業/政府.

exercises.source: 其首次將排放成本內部化
exercises.answer: It internalizes the cost of emissions for the first time
acceptableAnswers: it makes emission costs internal for the first time
it brings emission costs in-house for the first time
exercises.context: Policy analyst on a new climate rule
exercises.explanation: 其 (literary 'it') + 首次 (for the first time) + 內部化 (internalize).

exercises.prompt: Build "According to public documents, the policy covers about 70% or more of low-income urban and rural households"
exercises.answer: 據 公開 檔案 ， 約 覆蓋 城鄉 低 收入 家庭 七 成 以上

topics.title: Persuasion & debate
topics.description: Build arguments, concede, refute

guide.intro: Persuasive Chinese has its own choreography: state your premise, acknowledge the counter-argument, then refute. Three structures power the dance — conditionals (要是...就/便, 即使...也), the concessive 雖然...但是, and the rhetorical 難道...嗎.

sections.text: Conditionals

rows: As long as X, then Y
除非 X 否則 Y

rows.source: 要是你早點告訴我就好了。
rows.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ zǎo diǎn gàosù wǒ jiù hǎo le.
rows.translation: If only you had told me earlier.

rows.pinyin: Jíshǐ xiàyǔ, wǒmen yě yào qù.
rows.translation: Even if it rains, we are still going.

rows.source: 只要你努力，就一定會成功。
rows.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ nǔlì, jiù yídìng huì chénggōng.
rows.translation: As long as you work hard, you will surely succeed.

rows.source: 除非他道歉，否則我不會原諒他。
rows.pinyin: Chúfēi tā dàoqiàn, fǒuzé wǒ bú huì yuánliàng tā.
rows.translation: Unless he apologizes, I will not forgive him.

sections.text: 雖然...但是 — concede then push back
The strongest debaters concede. 雖然 X 但是 Y ("although X, but Y") signals you've heard the counterpoint and have an answer. Formal upgrade: 儘管 X，然而 Y.

rows.source: 雖然這個方案有風險，但是收益也很大。
rows.pinyin: Suīrán zhège fāng'àn yǒu fēngxiǎn, dànshì shōuyì yě hěn dà.
rows.translation: Although this plan has risks, the returns are also large.

rows.source: 儘管成本上升，然而公司仍然盈利。
rows.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn chéngběn shàngshēng, rán'ér gōngsī réngrán yínglì.
rows.translation: Although costs rose, the company is nevertheless still profitable.

sections.text: 難道...嗎 — rhetorical question
難道 ("could it really be that") fronts a question to which the speaker assumes the answer is obvious. Used to challenge an assumption or rebuke.

rows.translation: Could it be that you don't know? (You should know!)

rows.pinyin: Nándào zhè jiù shì dá'àn ma?
rows.translation: Is this really the answer?

sections.text: In writing, balance your concessives. A column that opens with 雖然...但是 and closes with 難道...嗎 reads as classic argumentative Chinese.

lessons.title: Stating your position
lessons.description: Open with confidence

exercises.prompt: the opener
Build "In my view, this view is one-sided"
exercises.answer: 在 我 看來 這個 觀點 比較 片面

exercises.prompt: Which is most formal for "I firmly believe"?
exercises.explanation: All four are plausible C1 alternatives, but 堅信 ("firmly believe") is the strongest and most formal — 深信 is close behind, 相信 is neutral, 認定 leans toward "conclude / be convinced".

exercises.prompt: Tap the verb of belief you hear
exercises.explanation: 認為 ("hold the view that") states a current belief; 以為 ("used to think / mistakenly thought") implies the speaker has since changed their mind. Mishearing one for the other flips the meaning.

exercises.prompt: Pick the strongest gradient ordering for verbs of belief:
options: 我深信 > 我堅信 > 我認為 > 我覺得 > 我以為 (mistaken)
我以為 > 我深信 > 我認為
我覺得 > 我深信 > 我以為
exercises.answer: 我深信 > 我堅信 > 我認為 > 我覺得 > 我以為 (mistaken)
exercises.explanation: Strength gradient runs from firm conviction to casual impression to mistaken prior view.

exercises.prompt: Build "In my humble view, this view, although appealing, is somewhat one-sided"
exercises.answer: 依 我 之 見 ， 這 一 觀點 雖 具 吸引力 ， 但 略 顯 片面

exercises.prompt: the position-marker to its register
Complete the formal opener: "在 ___ 看來，這一現象值得深思" (in our view)
exercises.explanation: 在我們看來 / 在我看來 = formal opinion frame.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch in this debate opener:
options: 依我之見，該方案存在嚴重缺陷
依我之見，這玩意兒壓根不行
在我看來，這個方案存在缺陷
我認為該方案需要進一步完善
exercises.answer: 依我之見，這玩意兒壓根不行
exercises.explanation: 依我之見 is literary; 這玩意兒/壓根 are colloquial. Mixing them sounds jarring.

exercises.prompt: Tap the strength of conviction you hear
exercises.explanation: 我深信 / 我堅信 / 我相信 / 我認為 sit at four points on the strength dial. C1 listening discriminates them.

exercises.source: 依我之見，這一觀點雖具吸引力，但略顯片面
exercises.answer: In my humble view, this view, although appealing, is somewhat one-sided
acceptableAnswers: from my perspective, this view is appealing yet rather one-sided
in my opinion, although this view is attractive, it is a bit one-sided
exercises.explanation: 依我之見 (formal opinion frame) + 雖...但 (concessive pivot) + 略顯片面 (somewhat one-sided).

exercises.prompt: Complete the formal opener: "在 ___ 看來，這一現象值得深思" (in our view)
exercises.explanation: 在我們看來 = formal collective opinion frame.

exercises.prompt: Which opener is MOST literary?
exercises.explanation: 依我之見 carries a classical-flavored register; the others sit at neutral or casual.

exercises.prompt: Build "I firmly believe that this view is one-sided"
exercises.answer: 我 堅信 這 一 觀點 較為 片面

exercises.prompt: Tap the literary opinion frame you hear
exercises.spokenText: 依我之見這一現象值得深思
options: 依我之見這一現象值得深思
在我看來這一現象值得深思
我覺得這一現象值得深思
依我之見這一現象無足輕重
exercises.answer: 依我之見這一現象值得深思
exercises.explanation: Listen for register (依我之見 vs 在我看來 vs 我覺得) and 值得/無足 (worth/insignificant).
毫無 (utterly without) + 疑問 (doubt).

exercises.prompt: Complete: "我 ___ 這一觀點" (firmly believe)
exercises.explanation: 堅信 / 深信 = firmly believe; both formal.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence preserves formal debate register throughout?
options: 依我之見，該方案存在嚴重缺陷
依我之見，這玩意兒壓根不行
我覺得這個方案啊不太行
exercises.answer: 依我之見，該方案存在嚴重缺陷
exercises.explanation: 依我之見 + 該方案 + 存在嚴重缺陷 keeps register internally consistent.

exercises.prompt: Build "Without a doubt, this issue warrants deep reflection"
exercises.answer: 毫無 疑問 ， 這 一 問題 值得 深思

lessons.title: Conditionals — 要是, 即使, 只要
lessons.description: Build hypothetical arguments

exercises.prompt: What does "即使下雨我們也要去" mean?
options: If it rains we won't go
Even if it rains we are still going
If it stops raining we'll go
We are going only if it rains
exercises.answer: Even if it rains we are still going

exercises.prompt: Build "As long as you work hard, you will succeed"
exercises.answer: 只要 你 努力 ， 就 一定 會 成功

exercises.prompt: the conditional
Complete: "___ 他道歉，否則我不會原諒他" (Unless...)
Build "Even if there are setbacks along the way, we will not give up"
exercises.answer: 即使 途 中 遭遇 挫折 ， 我們 也 不會 放棄

exercises.prompt: What does "假如換個角度看，問題或許更清晰" mean?
options: If we look from another angle, the problem may be clearer
exercises.answer: If we look from another angle, the problem may be clearer
exercises.explanation: 假如 = formal "should / suppose"; 或許 = soft hedge "perhaps".

exercises.prompt: the conditional to its strength
Complete: "___ 你願意傾聽，對方就會願意溝通" (As long as)
exercises.explanation: 只要 X 就 Y — sufficient-condition frame.

exercises.prompt: Tap the conditional you hear
exercises.spokenText: 除非他先道歉否則我們不會讓步
options: 除非他先道歉否則我們不會讓步
除非他先道歉否則我們一定讓步
只要他先道歉我們就會讓步
如果他先道歉我們就會讓步
exercises.answer: 除非他先道歉否則我們不會讓步
exercises.explanation: 除非...否則 vs 只要...就 vs 如果...就 differ in logic. C1 listening discriminates the necessary-condition frame.

exercises.prompt: Pick the formal hypothetical version of "if costs were to fall, demand would surge":
options: 假如成本下降，需求便會激增
要是成本掉了，需求就會漲
成本要是下來需求肯定上去
成本下來了需求就上去
exercises.answer: 假如成本下降，需求便會激增
exercises.explanation: 假如 + 便 + 激增 = formal economic-reasoning register.

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if it takes ten years, this goal still warrants the effort"
exercises.answer: 即使 需要 十 年 ， 這個 目標 仍 值得 我們 努力

exercises.source: 假如成本下降需求便會激增
exercises.answer: If costs fell, demand would surge
acceptableAnswers: should costs decline, demand would surge
if costs go down demand will rise sharply
exercises.explanation: 假如 (formal 'should / if') + 便 (formal 'then') + 激增 (surge).

exercises.prompt: Complete: "___ 他道歉，否則我不會原諒他" (Unless)
exercises.explanation: 除非...否則 = unless...otherwise.

exercises.prompt: Which conditional expresses a SUFFICIENT condition?
exercises.explanation: 只要 X 就 Y: X alone is enough to make Y happen.

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if it takes ten years, this goal still warrants the effort"
exercises.answer: 即使 需要 十 年 ， 這個 目標 仍 值得 我們 努力

exercises.prompt: Tap the necessary-condition frame you hear
exercises.spokenText: 除非他先道歉否則我們不會讓步
options: 除非他先道歉否則我們不會讓步
除非他先道歉否則我們一定讓步
只要他先道歉我們就會讓步
如果他先道歉我們就會讓步
exercises.answer: 除非他先道歉否則我們不會讓步
exercises.explanation: 除非...否則 vs 只要...就 vs 如果...就 differ in logic.

exercises.source: 即使途中遭遇挫折我們也不會放棄
exercises.answer: Even if we encounter setbacks along the way, we will not give up
acceptableAnswers: even with setbacks on the way we will not give up
though we meet setbacks we will not give up
exercises.explanation: 即使...也 = even if...still.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sufficient-condition frame: "___ 你願意傾聽，對方就會願意溝通" (As long as)
exercises.explanation: 只要 X 就 Y — sufficient condition.

exercises.prompt: Pick the most formal hypothetical for "if the policy were enacted, the market would respond":
options: 假如政策付諸實施，市場便會作出回應
要是政策出來了，市場就反應了
exercises.answer: 假如政策付諸實施，市場便會作出回應
exercises.explanation: 假如...便 + 付諸實施 + 作出回應 = formal economic-reasoning register.

exercises.prompt: Build "As long as you work hard, you will surely succeed"
exercises.answer: 只要 你 努力 ， 就 一定 會 成功

lessons.title: Concede & refute
lessons.description: 雖然...但是 / 儘管...然而

exercises.prompt: Build "Although this plan has risks, the returns are large"
exercises.answer: 雖然 這個 方案 有 風險 ， 但是 收益 很 大

exercises.prompt: Which is the most formal version of "although...however"?
exercises.explanation: 儘管...然而 belongs in essays, news, and formal speech.

exercises.prompt: Pick the sentence that concedes a point and pushes back:
options: 你說得有道理，但是我們也要看到另一面
exercises.answer: 你說得有道理，但是我們也要看到另一面

exercises.prompt: "你說得有道理" means "what you say is ___"
Build "Although the opposing view has its rationale, we still need to see another side"
exercises.answer: 儘管 對方 的 觀點 不無 道理 ， 然而 我們 仍需 看到 另一 面

exercises.prompt: What does the rebuttal structure "誠然...然而..." express?
options: Concede a point genuinely, then turn against it
exercises.answer: Concede a point genuinely, then turn against it
exercises.explanation: 誠然 ("granted / it is true that") + 然而 = a debater's classic concede-and-pivot.

exercises.prompt: the rebuttal opener
Tap the concession marker you hear
exercises.spokenText: 儘管成本上升然而公司仍然盈利
options: 儘管成本上升然而公司仍然盈利
雖然成本上升但是公司仍然盈利
儘管成本下降然而公司仍然盈利
儘管成本上升然而公司開始虧損
exercises.answer: 儘管成本上升然而公司仍然盈利
exercises.explanation: 儘管/雖然 differ in register; 上升/下降 inverts cause; 盈利/虧損 inverts result.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch in this concede-and-rebut:
options: 儘管對方觀點有合理之處，然而問題在於其忽視了長期影響
儘管你說的沒錯啊，但是問題在於這玩意兒沒用
誠然，該方案有其優勢，然而風險亦不容忽視
話雖如此，仍需考慮實際操作的可行性
exercises.answer: 儘管你說的沒錯啊，但是問題在於這玩意兒沒用
exercises.explanation: 儘管 lean formal; 你說的沒錯啊 / 這玩意兒沒用 are casual. Mixed register sounds inconsistent.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "雖然有問題但是值得嘗試" to formal: "___ 存在 不足 ， ___ 仍 值得 嘗試"
exercises.explanation: 儘管...然而 is the formal upgrade of 雖然...但是.

exercises.prompt: Build "That said, we still need to consider its impact on small and medium-sized enterprises"
exercises.answer: 話 雖 如此 ， 我們 仍 需 考慮 其 對 中小 企業 的 影響

exercises.source: 儘管對方的觀點不無道理，然而我們仍需看到另一面
exercises.answer: Although the opponent's view has its merits, we still need to see the other side
acceptableAnswers: though the other side has a point, we must still consider another angle
the opponent's view is not without merit, however we still need to look at the other side
exercises.explanation: 儘管...然而 + 不無道理 + 仍需 = formal debate register.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "雖然有問題但是值得嘗試" to formal: "___ 存在不足，___ 仍值得嘗試"
exercises.hint: Two parts of the formal concessive pair
exercises.explanation: 儘管...然而 is the formal upgrade of 雖然...但是.

exercises.prompt: Which is the most formal concede-and-rebut opener?
exercises.explanation: 誠然...然而... is the most formal debater's opener.

exercises.prompt: Build "That said, we still need to consider its impact on small and medium-sized enterprises"
exercises.answer: 話 雖 如此 ， 我們 仍 需 考慮 其 對 中小 企業 的 影響

exercises.prompt: Tap the formal concessive you hear
exercises.spokenText: 儘管成本上升然而公司仍然盈利
options: 儘管成本上升然而公司仍然盈利
雖然成本上升但是公司仍然盈利
儘管成本下降然而公司仍然盈利
儘管成本上升然而公司開始虧損
exercises.answer: 儘管成本上升然而公司仍然盈利
exercises.explanation: 儘管/雖然 differ in register; 上升/下降 inverts cause; 盈利/虧損 inverts result.
話 (words) + 雖 (although) + 如此 (so / thus).

exercises.prompt: Complete the concede-and-rebut: "___，該方案有其優勢，然而風險亦不容忽視" (granted)
exercises.explanation: 誠然 = granted / it is true that — a classic debater's opener.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence preserves formal debate register?
options: 儘管對方觀點有合理之處，然而問題在於其忽視了長期影響
儘管你說的沒錯啊，但是問題在於這玩意兒沒用
你說得對吧，可是這事不行
對方說得有道理可是沒用
exercises.answer: 儘管對方觀點有合理之處，然而問題在於其忽視了長期影響
exercises.explanation: 儘管...然而... + 合理之處 + 忽視了長期影響 = formal debate register.

exercises.prompt: Build "Although this plan has risks, the returns are large"
exercises.answer: 雖然 這個 方案 有 風險 ， 但是 收益 很 大

lessons.title: Rhetorical questions — 難道...嗎
lessons.description: Sharpen a point with a challenge

exercises.prompt: What does "難道你不知道嗎？" really mean?
options: A genuine question — does he/she know?
exercises.explanation: 難道...嗎 expects the answer "of course" or "of course not".

exercises.prompt: Build the rhetorical "Could this really be the only solution?"
exercises.answer: 難道 這 是 唯一 的 解決 辦法 嗎

exercises.prompt: the rhetorical opener
"難道你忘了嗎？" implies you ___ have forgotten
exercises.explanation: Rhetorically, the speaker assumes you remember.

exercises.prompt: Build the rhetorical "If even this is not a problem, then what could possibly be a problem?"
exercises.answer: 如果 這 都 不 算 問題 ， 那 還有 什麼 算 問題 呢

exercises.prompt: What does "試問，誰能在此情況下保持冷靜？" really argue?
options: Nobody could stay calm under such circumstances
exercises.answer: Nobody could stay calm under such circumstances
exercises.explanation: 試問 ("I ask") fronts a rhetorical challenge. The expected answer is the negative.

exercises.prompt: the advanced rhetorical question opener
Tap the rhetorical opener you hear
exercises.spokenText: 難道我們就這樣放棄嗎
options: 難道我們就這樣放棄嗎
難道我們就這樣堅持嗎
難道你們就這樣放棄嗎
我們難道這樣放棄了嗎
exercises.answer: 難道我們就這樣放棄嗎
exercises.explanation: Listen for 我們/你們 (we/you), 放棄/堅持 (give up/persist), and word order — all classic C1 traps.

exercises.prompt: Pick the literary rhetorical "how could we possibly tolerate this?":
exercises.explanation: 豈能 ("how could one possibly") + 此事 ("this matter") = literary register.

exercises.prompt: Complete the rhetorical opener: "___ 這就是事實的全部？" (could it really be that)
exercises.explanation: 難道 fronts a question with an obvious-to-the-speaker answer.

exercises.prompt: Build the literary rhetorical "How could we ignore so many warnings?"
exercises.answer: 如此 多 的 警告 ， 我們 豈 能 視而 不見
How could we possibly tolerate this matter
acceptableAnswers: how can we ever tolerate this
we could never tolerate this matter
exercises.explanation: 豈能 (how could one possibly) + 此事 (this matter).

exercises.prompt: Complete the literary rhetorical: "如此多的警告，我們 ___ 視而不見" (how could we)
exercises.explanation: 豈能 fronts a literary rhetorical question expecting a negative answer.

exercises.prompt: Which rhetorical opener is MOST literary?

topics.title: Chéngyǔ in context
topics.description: Eight high-frequency four-character idioms used the right way

guide.intro: 成語 (chéngyǔ) are four-character idioms that compress a story or principle into one phrase. There are thousands of them, but only a few hundred are actually high-frequency. We'll meet eight that you'll see weekly in news, conversation, and writing — and learn the contexts where each lands well.

sections.text: How idioms slot into sentences

成語 typically work as adjectives, adverbs, or full predicates. Most can stand alone as a four-character verb phrase: 一舉兩得 ("two birds, one stone") can be the whole verb. Some need a 是 or 的 frame to slot in: 這是一舉兩得的事.

rows.pinyin: Zhè zhēn shì yì jǔ liǎng dé.
rows.translation: This really is killing two birds with one stone.

rows.pinyin: Tā gōngzuò bàn tú ér fèi.
rows.translation: He gave up halfway through the work.

rows.pinyin: Jǐn shàng tiān huā de shèjì
rows.translation: An icing-on-the-cake design

sections.text: Eight to remember

rows: Win-win solution / two birds, one stone
Help when help is most needed
Enter the village, follow its customs
When in Rome, do as the Romans

sections.text: 錦上添花 vs 雪中送炭
These two are taught as a pair. 錦上添花 is help when things are already good — nice but not vital. 雪中送炭 is help in a crisis — the kind people remember forever. Pick the right one when praising someone.

rows.pinyin: Nǐ zhè shì xuě zhōng sòng tàn, xièxie!
rows.translation: This is help when I really needed it — thank you!

rows.pinyin: Bú suàn shénme, zhǐshì jǐn shàng tiān huā.
rows.translation: It's nothing, just a small bonus.

sections.text: Don't pile 成語 on top of 成語. One per paragraph in writing, one per minute in speech. Used sparingly they sound elegant; used densely they sound like a textbook.

topics.title: Abstract & philosophical
topics.description: Talk about ideas, ethics, fate, and meaning

guide.intro: Modern Mandarin still leans on a small cluster of fate-and-cause vocabulary inherited from Confucian, Buddhist, and Daoist thought. Three words do most of the work: 緣分 (fated connection), 因果 (cause and effect), and 命運 (destiny). They aren't religious jargon — speakers use them every day to talk about relationships, outcomes, and choices. Learning the cultural framing keeps you from translating them too flatly.

sections.text: 緣分 — the right people, the right time

緣分 (yuán fèn) names the unseen tie that brings two people, or a person and a place, together. It's used loosely in romance ("we have 緣分"), friendship ("我們很有緣"), and even chance encounters. The Buddhist root is 緣 ("condition that gives rise to a meeting"); the modern register is warm, slightly fatalistic, and very common.

rows.source: 我們能再見面，真是緣分。
rows.pinyin: Wǒmen néng zài jiànmiàn, zhēn shì yuán fèn.
rows.translation: That we could meet again is truly fate.

rows.pinyin: Yǒu yuán qiān lǐ lái xiāng huì.
rows.translation: If fated, even a thousand miles can't keep two from meeting.

rows.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì jiù suí yuán ba.
rows.translation: Let's just let this one go where fate takes it.

sections.text: 因果 — cause and effect

因果 (yīn guǒ) literally pairs 因 (cause) with 果 (fruit / result). In Buddhist usage it names karma; in modern speech it works as a neutral "cause and effect" — useful in argument, science writing, and ethics talk alike. The four-character expression 因果報應 ("karmic retribution") keeps the moral edge.

rows.pinyin: Fán shì dōu yǒu yīn guǒ.
rows.translation: Every event has a cause and an effect.

rows.source: 我們要分析這件事的因果關係。
rows.pinyin: Wǒmen yào fēnxī zhè jiàn shì de yīn guǒ guānxi.
rows.translation: We need to analyse the causal relationship of this matter.

rows.pinyin: Zhòng shàn yīn, dé shàn guǒ.
rows.translation: Plant good causes, reap good fruits.

sections.text: 命運 — destiny you can argue with

命運 (mìng yùn) is destiny, but with more give than the English word suggests. Speakers talk about 改變命運 ("change one's destiny") and 與命運抗爭 ("struggle against fate") freely — destiny is fixed enough to name, fluid enough to push against. Adjacent terms: 天命 (heavenly mandate, more solemn), 宿命 (predetermined fate, fatalistic).

rows: Neutral; can be changed in modern usage

sections.text: These words sit in everyday conversation, not just temples. A friend who lands a job they nearly missed will say 這就是緣分; a parent reflecting on a child's path will say 改變命運. Don't over-translate them as "karma" or "fate" — let the context pick the English.

levels.name: C2 — Mastery
levels.description: Read novels, parse classical-flavored prose, debate philosophy, and switch register at will.

topics.title: Classical echoes (文言)
topics.description: The 之/其/所/而 family — and how they survive in modern formal writing

guide.intro: You will not be writing 文言 (wényán, classical Chinese) — almost no one does. But every Chinese newspaper editorial, legal document, government report, and serious novel is studded with classical particles, fossilized syntax, and four-character compressions that only make sense if you can read the classical underneath. Treat this as the X-ray vision unit.

sections.text: 之 (zhī) — the all-purpose connector

In modern colloquial Chinese 之 is replaced by 的. In formal writing 之 returns: it links a modifier to a noun (愛國之心 — "a heart of patriotism"), substitutes for an object pronoun (取而代之 — "take it and replace it"), and lurks inside dozens of 成語. Whenever you see 之 in a modern text, mentally swap in 的 or "it" and the sentence usually clicks.

rows.translation: What is said has reason — "that has merit."
To sum it up — used to open a closing paragraph.
A treasure of no price — priceless.

sections.text: 其 (qí) — "its / their / the said"

其 is the formal third-person possessive and a gentle determiner. In a contract you will read 其責任 (its/the responsibility). In an editorial: 其原因有三 (the reasons are three). Notice it never takes 的 after it.

rows.translation: In fact (lit. "its truth").
Each gets their proper place.
Among them / within it.

sections.text: 所 (suǒ) — turns a verb into "that which is V-ed"

所 + verb makes a passive-flavored relative clause: 所說 (that which is said), 所做 (that which is done), 所謂 (so-called). Pair it with 的 in modern usage to keep it readable: 我所說的話 — "the words I said." Reporters love this construction.

rows.translation: As is known to all — newspaper opener.
Unprecedented (lit. "never before existed").
The so-called experts — heavy with skepticism.

sections.text: 而 (ér) — "and / yet / and so"

而 fuses two predicates. Coordinative (年輕而有為 — young and capable), adversative (富而不驕 — rich yet not arrogant), or sequential (起而行之 — rise and act). Modern formal speech is full of it: spoken 而 sounds bookish; written 而 sounds polished.

Quick test: if you can replace 而 with English "and", "yet", or "thus" without losing the sense, you've parsed it. If none fit, you're probably looking at the fossilized 然而 (however) or 因而 (therefore).
Other classical fossils still alive

rows: 以…為… ("take X as Y"), 以便, 以免
若…則… ("if…then…"), 否則, 然則
幾乎, 在乎, 不亦樂乎
記者, 學者, 讀者, 強者
之乎者也 — the cliché of pedantry

sections.text: 之乎者也 (zhī hū zhě yě) is itself an idiom — it means "empty pedantic talk," mocking someone who hides behind classical jargon.

Don't conflate the two 也. Modern 也 is the high-frequency adverb "also / too" (我也去 — "I'm going too"). Classical 也 is a sentence-final marker that functioned roughly as a copula or assertion (… ， … 也 — "… is the case"). Same character, completely different jobs. In the table above, 也 is listed under its classical job; in everyday reading 99% of 也 you'll see is the modern adverb.
Literary number pairs

In literary or written-elevated register, paired numbers function adverbially to mean "a few / scattered." 一二 (yī èr) — "one or two," 三五 (sān wǔ) — "a handful," 七八 (qī bā) — "seven or eight, a small group." These appear in essays, captions, and novels — almost never in speech.

rows.source: 三五 好友 圍爐 夜話。
rows.translation: A handful of close friends chatting around the stove at night.

rows.source: 一二 行人 匆匆 而 過。
rows.pinyin: Yī èr xíngrén cōngcōng ér guò.
rows.translation: A pedestrian or two hurrying past.

lessons.title: 之 in modern prose
lessons.description: Spot 之 inside fixed phrases and editorials

exercises.prompt: In a modern editorial, 之 most often functions like which colloquial particle?
exercises.explanation: 之 is the formal counterpart of 的 — it links a modifier to a noun in elevated register. The other particles (地 adverbial, 得 complement, 而 connector) handle distinct grammatical jobs.

exercises.prompt: the 之-idiom to its meaning
總而言之，通脹壓力未減。
exercises.hint: An economics column ends with this — what is the writer signaling?
exercises.explanation: 總而言之 = "in conclusion / all in all" — a discourse marker for the wrap-up paragraph.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence uses 之 in its classical-modern formal sense (modifier-linker)?
options: 他 走 之 後 我 才 來
國家 之 強盛 在 於 民
我 也 去 之
之 是 什麼 意思
exercises.answer: 國家 之 強盛 在 於 民
exercises.explanation: 國家之強盛 ("the strength of the nation") uses 之 as the formal modifier-linker = 的. The other options misuse 之 — option 1 is a fixed adverbial (走之後 is colloquial 之後), the others ungrammatical.

exercises.prompt: Build a long formal sentence: "The development of artificial intelligence is the great trend of our age, and it is irreversible."
exercises.answer: 人工智慧 之 發展 乃 時代 之 大勢 不可 逆轉

exercises.prompt: A speaker reads a formal editorial line. Pick what you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 言之有理，行之有效，方為治世之策
options: 言之有理，行之有效，方為治世之策
說得有道理，做得很有效，才是治理的好辦法
言而有信，行而果斷，是治世的關鍵
話說得對，事做得好，國家就能治理
exercises.answer: 言之有理，行之有效，方為治世之策
exercises.explanation: Three uses of 之 (modifier-linker) plus 方為 (literary 才是) and 之策 (formal -strategy). The other options paraphrase the same idea in modern colloquial or near-colloquial register.

exercises.prompt: each 之-construction to the modern 的-equivalent (or paraphrase)

pairs.right: 改革的困難 — the difficulty of reform
一天的功夫 — a single day's effort
國家的根本 — the root of the nation
切身的痛苦 — pain felt in the flesh

exercises.prompt: 非一日之功可解。
exercises.hint: An editorial uses this phrasing — what is the 非…可… pattern?
options: Classical negation pattern — "not something a day's effort can solve"
exercises.answer: Classical negation pattern — "not something a day's effort can solve"
exercises.explanation: 非 X 可 Y = literary "not X-able by Y" — a fossilized classical negation that survives in editorials. Modern colloquial would say "不是一天就能解決的."

exercises.prompt: An editorial closes: "扶貧攻堅，非 ___ 之 ___ 可 成." Fill the two-character pair (a single day's effort).
exercises.explanation: 非一日之功可成 — "cannot be done in a day's effort." A boilerplate editorial closer that quietly hedges expectations.
無價 (without price) + 之 (formal 的) + 寶 (treasure).

exercises.prompt: An editorial closes: "教育乃國___大計." Fill the formal modifier-linker (one character).
exercises.explanation: 國之大計 = the great strategy of the nation. 之 is the formal modifier-linker.

exercises.prompt: 取而代之
exercises.explanation: 之 stands for an antecedent object — "replace IT." 而 sequences the two verbs.

exercises.prompt: Build: "The rise of this generation is a great event of our age." (formal)
exercises.answer: 此 代 之 崛起 乃 時代 之 大事

exercises.prompt: each phrase to its discourse role
A formal speech opener is read. Pick what you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 國之根本，在於民；民之所盼，乃政之所行
options: 國之根本，在於民；民之所盼，乃政之所行
國家的根本是人民，人民期盼什麼，政府就做什麼
國家最重要的是百姓，老百姓要什麼，政府就給什麼
對國家來說人民是根，他們的願望就是政策
exercises.answer: 國之根本，在於民；民之所盼，乃政之所行
exercises.explanation: Four 之-linkers plus 乃 (formal copula) and 所 + verb construction — high literary register. Distractors paraphrase in colloquial.

exercises.prompt: A speech ends: "此乃人民___所望。" Fill the formal modifier-linker.
exercises.hint: 之 or 的 — pick the literary one.
exercises.explanation: 人民之所望 — "that which the people hope for." 之 + 所 + verb is a classical relative-clause builder still alive in speeches.

acceptableAnswers: pain that cuts to the skin
exercises.explanation: 切膚 (cutting the skin) + 之 (formal 的) + 痛 (pain). A literary set phrase still widely used.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence uses 之 in the CLASSICAL pronoun sense (= him/it/them)?
options: 我 以 此 為 戒 以 警 之
exercises.answer: 我 以 此 為 戒 以 警 之
exercises.explanation: 警之 = "warn them." 之 here is the classical object pronoun (= him/her/it/them). The other three use 之 as a modifier-linker (= 的).

exercises.prompt: Build: "It is no easy task — not a thing a single day's effort can accomplish." (formal)
exercises.answer: 此 非 易 事 非 一日 之 功 可 成

lessons.title: 其 and 所 — formal relatives
lessons.description: The two particles that turn modern prose into a contract

exercises.prompt: 其原因有三
exercises.hint: What does this phrase most naturally mean?
exercises.explanation: 其 = "its/their"; 有三 = "are three (in number)." Classic essay-opener.

exercises.prompt: 所謂的專家
exercises.hint: Which tone does this phrase carry?
exercises.explanation: 所謂 = "so-called." Almost always loaded with doubt or sarcasm in modern usage.

exercises.prompt: the 所-phrase to its meaning

pairs.right: Naturally / as a matter of course

exercises.prompt: Build: "This is what we said." (formal)
exercises.answer: 這 是 我們 所 說 的

exercises.prompt: 其責任由甲方承擔。
exercises.hint: In this contract sentence, what does 其 refer to?
options: The responsibility just defined in the prior clause
exercises.answer: The responsibility just defined in the prior clause
exercises.explanation: 其 = formal possessive/anaphor — "its responsibility" (i.e., the responsibility belonging to whatever was last named). Standard contract glue.

exercises.prompt: Build a contract clause: "The responsibility for it shall be borne by Party A; the costs shall also be paid by Party A."
exercises.answer: 其 責任 由 甲方 承擔 其 費用 亦 由 甲方 支付

exercises.prompt: A reporter reads a sentence stuffed with 所 and 其. Pick the formal version.
exercises.spokenText: 眾所周知，其影響之深遠，前所未有
options: 眾所周知，其影響之深遠，前所未有
大家都知道，這影響很深遠，從來沒有過
據說，這事影響很大，是頭一回
我們清楚，影響很大，史上第一次
exercises.answer: 眾所周知，其影響之深遠，前所未有
exercises.explanation: Two 所-constructions (眾所周知, 前所未有), 其 + 之 chain. The distractors paraphrase in modern colloquial, official, or semi-formal registers.

exercises.prompt: A government white paper writes "___ 周知，氣候變化已成全球共同挑戰." Fill in the four-character all-knowing opener.
exercises.explanation: 眾所周知 = "as is known to all" — the canonical 所-construction opener for editorials and policy papers.

exercises.prompt: each 其/所 phrase to its discourse function
Which sentence uses 所 INCORRECTLY for a C2 reader?
exercises.explanation: 所 + verb forms a noun-clause but only with transitive verbs taking an object that becomes the head — and 所吃飯 is ungrammatical because 吃飯 is already V+O. Correct would be 我所吃的飯. The other three are well-formed.

exercises.answer: the responsibility for it shall be borne by Party A
acceptableAnswers: the responsibility shall be borne by Party A
Party A shall bear the responsibility
responsibility for it is borne by Party A
exercises.explanation: 其 = formal anaphor ("its / their"); 由…承擔 = formal passive "shall be borne by."

exercises.prompt: A policy paper begins: "___ 周知，氣候問題已迫在眉睫." Fill the canonical four-character all-knowing opener.
exercises.explanation: 眾所周知 = "as is known to all" — the textbook 所 opener for editorials.

exercises.prompt: 理所當然
exercises.hint: What does this set phrase assert?
options: It is self-evident / a matter of course
exercises.answer: It is self-evident / a matter of course
exercises.explanation: 理 (reason) + 所 + 當然 (naturally) — "as reason makes it natural." Used to assert a claim as obvious.

exercises.prompt: Build: "This is what the people hope for." (formal)
exercises.answer: 此 乃 人民 所 望

exercises.explanation: 前 (before) + 所 + 未有 (never had) — a classical four-character compression for "unprecedented."

exercises.prompt: A formal report opener is read aloud. Pick what you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 眾所周知，所謂的改革，其難度前所未有
options: 眾所周知，所謂的改革，其難度前所未有
大家都知道，這種改革很難，從沒見過
我們都明白，改革難度很大，史無前例
據說，改革的事情很複雜，難度不小
exercises.answer: 眾所周知，所謂的改革，其難度前所未有
exercises.explanation: Three 所-phrases (眾所周知, 所謂, 前所未有) plus 其 — stacked register markers. Distractors say similar things colloquially.

exercises.prompt: 無所謂
exercises.hint: Choose the closest reading in everyday use.
options: It doesn't matter / one is indifferent
exercises.answer: It doesn't matter / one is indifferent
exercises.explanation: 無 (none) + 所謂 (so-called / what is called) — literally "there is nothing to call it," so "it doesn't matter."

exercises.prompt: A contract clause: "___ 費用由乙方支付." Fill the formal anaphor (one character).
exercises.hint: The formal counterpart of 它的 / 這些.
exercises.explanation: 其 = formal possessive/anaphor — "its (i.e. the costs just mentioned)."

exercises.prompt: Which sentence uses 所 INCORRECTLY?
options: 我 所 說 的 話
前 所 未 有 的 事
眾 所 周 知 的 道理
我 所 看 電影
exercises.answer: 我 所 看 電影
exercises.explanation: 所 + V forms a noun-clause head; 我所看的電影 (= the movie I watched) is correct, but 所看電影 with no 的 is ungrammatical.

exercises.prompt: Build: "What is so-called expertise is in truth only superficial knowledge."
exercises.answer: 所謂 的 專業 其 實 不過 是 皮毛

lessons.title: 而 — the bookish glue
lessons.description: And, yet, thus — depending on what flanks it

exercises.prompt: 富而不驕 (fù ér bù jiāo)
exercises.explanation: Adversative 而 — "X yet not Y." A standard literary praise pattern.

exercises.prompt: 年輕而有為
exercises.hint: Pick the most natural English translation.
exercises.explanation: Coordinative 而 — both qualities hold. 有為 (yǒu wéi) = "capable / promising."

exercises.prompt: Build: "He spoke briefly yet to the point."
exercises.answer: 他 說 得 簡短 而 中肯

exercises.explanation: 然而 = literally "yet-and"; the workhorse contrastive in essays.

exercises.prompt: A literary-register sentence is read aloud. Pick what you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 眾所周知，前所未有之變局，非一日之功可解
options: 眾所周知，前所未有之變局，非一日之功可解
大家都知道，這種沒見過的局面，不是一天就能解決的
我們都明白，這是從來沒有過的事情，需要時間
據報道，目前局勢複雜，有關部門正在研究
exercises.answer: 眾所周知，前所未有之變局，非一日之功可解
exercises.explanation: Classical fossils all stacked: 眾所周知 (所), 前所未有 (所), 之 (formal of), 非…可解 (classical negation pattern). The other options say similar things in modern colloquial or official register.

exercises.prompt: 取而代之
exercises.hint: What is the role of 而 in this chengyu?
exercises.explanation: 取而代之 = "take, and replace it." The 而 here is the sequential connector — first 取, then 代之.

exercises.prompt: Build a literary-balanced sentence: "He is young yet steady; he speaks little but acts decisively."
exercises.answer: 他 年輕 而 沉穩 言 寡 而 行 果

exercises.prompt: the 而-phrase to its function (coordinative / adversative / sequential)

pairs.right: Fossilized discourse marker — to sum up

exercises.prompt: An essay reads: "政策推行 三年，___ 收效甚微." Fill the formal contrastive connector (one character).
exercises.explanation: 然 (or 然而) — formal "yet/however." The single-character 然 is the most literary; 然而 is essay-standard. 但 is more conversational.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence-final 也 is the CLASSICAL copula (not the modern "also")?
options: 他 也 不 知道
此 乃 國 之 大 事 也
你 也 來 了
exercises.answer: 此 乃 國 之 大 事 也
exercises.explanation: Classical 也 is sentence-final and assertion-like (≈ "is the case"). Pairs naturally with 此乃 ("this is") + 之 in literary register. The other three are modern adverbial 也 = "also/too."
然 (so / thus) + 而 (yet) — the workhorse essay contrastive.

exercises.prompt: An essay shift: "政策 推 行 三 年，___ 收效 甚微." Fill the formal contrastive (two characters).
exercises.explanation: 然而 — "however / yet." The literary turn. 然 alone is also acceptable in higher registers.

exercises.prompt: 富而不驕
exercises.explanation: Adversative 而 — "wealthy, yet not arrogant." A literary praise pattern.

exercises.prompt: Build (literary): "He is young yet steady; he speaks little yet his words have weight."
exercises.answer: 他 年輕 而 沉穩 言 少 而 有 分量

exercises.prompt: the 而-construction to its function
A literary-register sentence is read aloud. Pick what you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 改革者，難而必行；改革之路，遠而不可棄
options: 改革者，難而必行；改革之路，遠而不可棄
改革這件事很難，但一定要做，路雖遠不能放棄
改革很難做，但必須做，前路漫長不可丟棄
搞改革，難度大，但要堅持，路遠也要走完
exercises.answer: 改革者，難而必行；改革之路，遠而不可棄
exercises.explanation: Two adversative 而 + 之 + 者 — high literary register. Distractors paraphrase in modern Mandarin.

exercises.answer: rise up and act on it
exercises.explanation: 起 (rise) + 而 (sequential) + 行 (act) + 之 (it). Sequential 而 plus classical pronoun 之.

exercises.prompt: A line of praise: "敏 ___ 好 學，言 ___ 中 肯." Fill the literary coordinator (one character, twice).
exercises.explanation: 敏而好學 (sharp and fond of learning) — a Lúnyǔ allusion. 而 coordinates parallel praise.

exercises.prompt: Which 而 is the SEQUENTIAL one ("and then")?
options: 富 而 不 驕
取 而 代 之
總 而 言 之
exercises.answer: 取 而 代 之
exercises.explanation: 取而代之 = "take, and then replace it" — first take, then substitute. The others are coordinative, adversative, or fossilized discourse markers.

exercises.prompt: Build (formal contrast): "The policy may sound elegant, yet in practice it is hard to apply."
exercises.answer: 此 策 聽 之 雅 然 而 行 之 難

lessons.title: 以、則、者 — the rest of the toolkit
lessons.description: Three more classical particles you'll trip over weekly

exercises.prompt: "以…為…" means:
options: Take X as / regard X as Y
exercises.answer: Take X as / regard X as Y
exercises.explanation: 以學生為本 = "take students as the foundation" — boilerplate education-policy phrasing. (The canonical example is 以人為本 — rén-běn — "put people first," the Hu-era policy slogan.)

exercises.prompt: Build: "Our company puts the customer first." (use 以…為…)
exercises.answer: 我們 公司 以 客戶 為 本

exercises.prompt: "若…則…" is the formal counterpart of which everyday pattern?
exercises.explanation: Both are conditionals. 若…則… is the literary register; 要是…就… is colloquial.

exercises.prompt: the 者-noun to its meaning

acceptableAnswers: speaks pretentiously / hides behind pedantic jargon
exercises.explanation: All four are classical particles bundled together — a label for hollow learnedness.

exercises.prompt: the classical compression to its modern function (these still appear in editorials and legal documents)

pairs.right: Therefore / for this reason (= 因此, formal)
That being so / in that case (= 那麼)
Why is that? (rhetorical question, = 為什麼)
X's relation to Y / X compared to Y

exercises.prompt: 是以本院駁回原告之訴訟請求。
exercises.hint: In this legal-opinion sentence, what does 是以 function as?
exercises.explanation: 是以 = 因此 / 所以 in elevated register. Watch for it in court opinions, government white papers, and editorial conclusions.

exercises.prompt: Build a formal conditional: "If the policy goes through, then the people will benefit; if not, then losses will mount day by day."
exercises.answer: 政策 若 行 則 民 受 其 利 不 行 則 損 日 增

exercises.prompt: A speaker reads a 文言-flavored editorial close. Pick what you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 是以本部門決定，自即日起，相關政策依法施行
options: 是以本部門決定，自即日起，相關政策依法施行
因此我們部門決定，從今天開始，相關政策按法律執行
所以這個部門決定，從這天開始，要按規定辦理
據此，部門已經決定，今天起就開始執行
exercises.answer: 是以本部門決定，自即日起，相關政策依法施行
exercises.explanation: 是以 (formal 因此), 本部門 (this department), 自即日起 (formal 從今天開始), 依法施行 (formal "executed in accordance with law") — four register markers. The distractors translate the same content into ordinary or near-formal Chinese.

exercises.prompt: Pair completion: "___ 你 已 決定，則 不必 再 猶豫." Fill the literary premise marker (two characters).
exercises.explanation: 既然…則… (literary) = 既然…就… (modern). Both halves carry the conclusion forward; 則 is the bookish counterpart of 就.

exercises.prompt: Which use of 以 is the CLASSICAL "in order to / so as to" (purpose)?
options: 他 以 學生 的 身份 發言
我 以 此 為 戒 以 免 重 蹈 覆轍
用 這個 方法 解決
我 以為 他 不來
exercises.answer: 我 以 此 為 戒 以 免 重 蹈 覆轍
exercises.explanation: The second 以 in 以免 ("so as to avoid") is the classical purpose marker — same root as 以便 ("so as to facilitate"). The first 以 here is 以…為… ("take… as…"); option 1 is identity-marking 以; option 4 is the verb 以為 ("think").

acceptableAnswers: regard the people as the foundation
take the people as the foundation
exercises.explanation: 以…為… — "take X as Y." Famous policy slogan.

exercises.prompt: A legal opinion closes: "___ 以 本 院 駁 回 原 告 之 訴." Fill the formal demonstrative (one character).
exercises.explanation: 是以 = "therefore / for this reason" — fossil 是 + 以, found at the head of court opinions and white papers.

exercises.prompt: 若 政策 行 之 有 效，則 民 受 其 利。
exercises.hint: What is the function of 則 here?
exercises.explanation: 若…則… = literary "if…then…" Pair with colloquial 要是…就… for the everyday version.

exercises.prompt: Build: "This being so, then there is no need to hesitate further." (formal)
exercises.answer: 既然 如此 則 不必 再 猶豫

exercises.prompt: the 者-noun to a near-synonym
A legal-register sentence is read aloud. Pick what you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 是以本院駁回原告之訴訟請求
options: 是以本院駁回原告之訴訟請求
因此法院不接受原告的訴求
所以這個法院拒絕了起訴人的請求
據此，本院不予支援原告主張
exercises.answer: 是以本院駁回原告之訴訟請求
exercises.explanation: 是以 (formal therefore), 本院 (this court), 之 (formal 的), 訴訟請求 (claim of suit) — four literal-register markers. Distractors translate the same content in modern Chinese.
然 (so) + 則 (then) — "if that is so, then." A literary cohesive.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence uses 者 as a PRONOMINAL nominalizer ("the one who…")?
options: 這 是 一 個 學者
強 者 勝，弱 者 敗
這 部 電影 不 錯
exercises.answer: 強 者 勝，弱 者 敗

topics.title: Tang poetry foundations
topics.description: 李白, 杜甫, 王維 — the lines every educated speaker can quote

guide.intro: Tang dynasty (618–907) poetry is the cultural reservoir Chinese speakers draw on the way English speakers reach for Shakespeare. You don't need to read every poem — but the half-dozen lines below are quoted in WeChat moments, business toasts, news headlines, and movie titles. Knowing them is the difference between hearing a language and hearing a culture.

sections.text: 李白 — the romantic

Lǐ Bái (701–762), nicknamed 詩仙 (the Poetry Immortal). Famous for moonlit drinking, untethered imagination, and homesickness. His 靜夜思 (Quiet Night Thoughts) is the first poem Chinese children memorize.

rows.translation: Before my bed, bright moonlight —
I wondered if it were frost on the ground.
Lifting my head, I gazed at the bright moon —
Lowering it, I thought of my hometown.

sections.text: 故鄉 (gù xiāng — hometown) is the most-loaded word in classical Chinese. It still freights modern songs, Lunar New Year speeches, and diaspora literature.

Textual note: the 床前明月光 wording above is the Ming-dynasty redaction (the version every Chinese child memorizes today). The earlier Tang variant reads 床前看月光 / 疑是地上霜 / 舉頭望山月 / 低頭思故鄉. If you ever see 看月光 / 望山月 in an academic citation, it isn't a typo — it's the older edition.
杜甫 — the conscience

Dù Fǔ (712–770), 詩聖 (the Poetry Sage). Where Lǐ Bái soars, Dù Fǔ documents — war, hunger, the displaced family. His phrase 國破山河在 ("the nation shattered, mountains and rivers remain") is quoted whenever a country loses something it cannot replace.

rows.translation: The state is broken; the mountains and rivers remain.
Spring in the city — grass and trees grow thick.
Moved by the times, even flowers shed tears.

sections.text: 王維 — the painter-monk

Wáng Wéi (701–761) painted in words and wrote on silk. His couplets are nearly silent: a stream, a bell, a single bird. The phrase 詩中有畫，畫中有詩 ("poetry in his paintings, paintings in his poetry") was coined to describe him.

rows.translation: Empty mountain — no one in sight.
Only the echo of voices is heard.
Bright moon shines between the pines.

sections.text: 蘇軾 — the Song-dynasty bonus

Sū Shì (1037–1101) is technically Song, not Tang, but you cannot graduate without him. His line 但願人長久，千里共嬋娟 ("may we live long and share the moon's beauty across a thousand li") is the standard Mid-Autumn Festival blessing — printed on mooncake boxes nationwide.

rows.translation: May people endure (live long).
And share, across a thousand li, the moon's beauty.

rows.pinyin: Bù shí Lú shān zhēn miàn mù
rows.translation: I cannot see Mount Lu's true face —

rows.pinyin: Zhǐ yuán shēn zài cǐ shān zhōng
rows.translation: Only because I myself am in the mountain.

sections.text: Su Shi's couplet shares a sensibility with the proverb 當局者迷 ("the one inside the game is confused") — but the proverb itself comes from 舊唐書 (the Old Book of Tang), not from 題西林壁. They are quoted side by side because they say the same thing from different angles.
